title: Kamishiro Rui — Card Story

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hm... I may not be able to do all the lighting effects I want with the number of illuminations on Wonder Stage...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The lighting effects that can be done on an outdoor stage like that are quite limited to begin with. And I have to try to match them to Tsukasa's image as well...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: (Kamishiro never takes notes in class. He's usually doodling or writing some kind of formula instead...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I know. We just have to figure out the optimal amount of light needed according to the weather that day. I'll get Tsukasa to help me with the calculations later...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: (Whoa. He just broke into a smile over nothing. He's as crazy as the rumors say...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's see... Is Tsukasa in his classroom?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Rui! Just the person I was looking for!
I need to talk to you about something.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So do I, but let's hear what you have to say first.
Go ahead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hehehe... Look at this!
It's a flyer publicizing our show!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wow, when did you come up with that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
A future star must always look ahead!
What do you think? Not bad for something hand drawn, eh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it's quite well done, actually.
You're surprisingly good at this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why is it surprising?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, I need you to help me fold them all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that would make them easier to distribute. But since you're asking for help, there must be quite a lot of flyers to fold, then?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. That whole stack over there. Right there!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Right... That's a lot of flyers.
There must be hundreds.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Come on, this should be quick and easy with two of us!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No thanks.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I refuse to do something so inefficient. We can't finish folding so many flyers before school ends. This is just going to be a giant waste of time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What are you saying?! These flyers will help to publicize our show! And you're calling them a waste of time?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, let me finish. The thing is, we don't have to do it ourselves, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Exactly what I just said. Well then, I'll see you again at the next break time, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We can talk about what I want later.)
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hey, thanks for waiting. Here's what you need.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Rui!
Wait, what's that little printer-like device for?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A flyer folding machine I made from the robots I had on hand and equipment borrowed from the school's garbage pile.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Put the machine on the desk and secure this arm to the desk edge. The arm will serve as the tray for folded flyers.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh huh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It uses the robot's battery so you don't have to plug it in. Then, feed the flyer into the insertion part and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa! The paper got sucked inside! Wow...
And it came back out folded in half!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The folded paper landed perfectly inside the arm!
No need to worry about them scattering everywhere like that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Exactly. Basically, all you have to do is feed the paper into the machine. Easy, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Indeed!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, it's just a simplified version of the folding machines available on the market, but the functionality is there. Only for folding flyers, though.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Not bad at all, Rui!
You made this during class just now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's right. And I finished it sooner than expected, so I input a paper airplane folding function into the robot's AI as well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: O-Okay. Not sure what that means, but it sounds awesome!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Keep the machine going throughout your classes and the flyers should be all folded by the time school's over.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Got it! Thanks, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, thank you for providing a place for the machine!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? You're welcome?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He usually gives me a hard time because of his strange ideas, but he can be quite helpful when needed, huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, I just have to feed the flyers into the machine and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Wait a minute.
Did he just say I needed to keep the machine going throughout my classes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He wants me to keep folding the flyers at my seat?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah! That's what he meant by providing a place... C-Curses!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui! You little...
I can't take my classes like this!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe...
Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh dear, over here too?
I almost missed that one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?
What's Rui doing at the flowerbed...gasp!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is he already making preparations for another frightful piece of stage direction that he recently dreamed up?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Rui!
What crazy scheme are you up to this time?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What is it? Why the terrified look?
I'm just pulling weeds, you know?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: S-Say what? So, you're trying to do something with weeds?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm not doing anything with them.
The poor flowers won't get any sun if I don't pull out the weeds, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What the?! The person who tries to light me on fire or blast me into orbit is feeling sorry for flowers?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You can't possibly be so humane!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's a lot of ruckus about me just pulling weeds.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Aha! A fever!
You must be having an incredibly high fever, right?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not. I'm only doing what's expected of me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ex-Expected?! You being nice to flowers is expected?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm in the greening committee, you know.
Wouldn't you expect the greening committee to care for flowers?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Would you expect someone who uses class time to make strange robots to take his committee duties so seriously?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In fact, it'd make more sense if you'd used one of your strange machines to do the job for you, right?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that would probably be more efficient. However, you need some delicacy and finesse for this, or you may end up hurting the flowers instead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're worried about hurting the flowers?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't you ever get tired of overreacting?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not acting surprised for fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I still can't believe you're just trying to do committee work. You must be plotting something devious...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Sigh...
Ah, by the way, Tsukasa, you're afraid of bugs, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Eek! Wh-What do you mean?
There's nothing in this world I'm afraid of—

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: GYAAAH!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's just a caterpillar, you don't have to be so... Ah.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Urk!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wow. That was quite a neat tumble.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: ... *twitch*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sorry I had knock you off your feet like that. You really should be watching where you go. You almost stepped on that flower, you know.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now then... I guess you must have fallen out when they were sowing the seeds. Don't grow here all by yourself. Come here instead.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This should be a good place.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ugh. I was wondering why the sudden attack...
You did it for that flower, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can't possibly watch you stamp on the flower before my very eyes now, can I?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... I had no idea you were such a big lover of flowers. I apologize for not believing you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm not bothered by that.
And I wouldn't call myself a lover of flowers, really. More like...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahh?! Look at what you've done to my uniform!
I need to clean off all this mud quickly!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh... There he goes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Looks like Tsukasa hasn't realized just how wonderful all of you are, yet.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How you're able to bring a smile to someone's face by just blooming beautifully right there.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, that's the end of my work on your stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't stop performing your lovely shows for us here.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (There's nothing else to do here. I'll just go home.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hmm? Is that Nene singing?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She's practicing in front of Robo-Nene?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm glad that she's now comfortable performing on stage in person but...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She always brings Robo-Nene with her, both to our rehearsals and shows. It seems she needs her for reassurance.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I hope you enjoyed my song!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm no longer afraid of performing on stage, but that's only thanks to you, Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Without you next to me, I lose confidence again...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Just as I thought...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I can't leave it like this.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm, this explains a lot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So that's why you kept bringing Robo-Nene here, even though she's already served her original purpose.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Eek!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I... I thought you'd gone home...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, I do apologize for eavesdropping.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm pleased you've been taking such good care of Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's already accomplished the mission I had set out for her when I built her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But it seems it's too early to retire her.
She's still needed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have a proposition. You would have to let me take her from you for a short while, though. Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What are you planning to do?
Are you going to modify her?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not quite.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm just going to tweak her a little so that she'll serve you better... Serve us all better, as a member of our troupe and a wonderful addition to our shows.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You mean... You'll make it so that she can perform together with us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
If that is what you want.
Is it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then I'll happily take care of her for you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How do you envision her role in our shows?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'd like her to be able to do all sorts of different things together with us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And have her perform without me having to remotely control her every action.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
In that case...
I'll have to make her partly autonomous.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'll install an AI.
She'll be able to talk a little.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She would of course need facial and voice recognition software as well. Hmm, I'll have to expand her memory.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems I've got my work cut out for me!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You look happy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I am. I have all these exciting ideas hatching in my head.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I can't wait to test them out...
Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're not going to make her into a giant robot, or give her transformation abilities, are you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait and you'll see.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But remember I won't like it if you add any weird functions to her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Heh, I won't. All new features will be designed specifically to make you and our audience happy!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's keeping Rui?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He said he'd be gone just a moment, but we've been waiting here for ages!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Calm down, he's only been gone for three minutes. Even dogs have more patience.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you saying I'm worse than a dog?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Apologies for the wait.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, it's not right to call people over just to make them wait...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Eek, a spooky ghost in a red cape!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I think this may put you in a better mood, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let me guess. You finished upgrading Robo-Nene?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Bingo.
Would you like to see her?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yesss! Show us, show us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I want to see her too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph, let's see if it can impress me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, I'd like a drum roll first.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You want what?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A drum roll. You know, to set the mood.
I'm about to reveal my newest creation after all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ba-dum! Ba-ba-ba-boom-boom-baaah♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Are just you going to beatbox it?!
Anyway, it didn't sound like a drum roll at all!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Looks like I have to show you how to do it.
Are you ready? Dum-dum-dum! Is anyone going to join in, or what?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Got it! Ba-ba-ba-boom♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sigh...
Ba-ba-ba-dum-tsss...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then! Feast your eyes!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oooh... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It looks the same as before...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehehe. Don't judge the book by its cover.
Nene, come stand in front of Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Hail thee, Miss Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She... She can speak?!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Miss Nene, I bring you an offering of grapefruit juice.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She produced a can of grapefruit juice from a hidden compartment inside her arm? It's even chilled.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooow!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've installed an AI and a facial recognition system. Besides us, she can also remember audience members.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In addition to that, I equipped her with a few new features which should be a great hit with children.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What features are those?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Let's have a demonstration.
Tsukasa, could you stand over there?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is here okay?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that's perfect.
Wait there while we back off a little.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hold on, why are you backing off?!
Is this going to be dangerous? Am I at risk here?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Robo-Nene, fire!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Initiating Rocket Punch... Fire!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Aaargh! Huh...?
It stopped an inch from my face?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As you can see, there's a built-in safety feature preventing the rocket from hitting anything, but you should never aim it at people, just as an extra precaution.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, do I not count as people?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This was an example illustrating what you should not do under any circumstances.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you for your cooperation, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're welco—no!
Don't mess with me, Rui. I didn't know what I was signing up for!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, there's more to Robo-Nene's new move.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't pretend you didn't hear me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sure you're going to be blown away by this nifty little trick, Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wooow!
Robo-Nene's fist exploded!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A hidden party popper? It spooked the pigeons!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That was actually fun!
Kids are going to love it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe, he forgot all about being upset.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nene, penny for your thoughts.
Do you like your robot's upgrades?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Miss Nene, how do you evaluate me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Can you change it so that she calls me just Nene?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, sure. I take it that all the other features have earned your approval.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene, Rui, Robo-Nene!
Thank you for joining our troupe☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's make every show of ours a fantastic one together!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that would be nice.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well then, without further ado, let's discuss what sort of production we should be doing for our next per—

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Before that, I have something to pass to Rui and Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, is that...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Yes, this is a staff entry permit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We only accepted the job yesterday.
I didn't think we would be able to get our permits so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Looks like Mr. Mascot is very competent at his job. He doesn't make any unnecessary movements, too.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm guessing he must be Emu's bodyguard?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you for the quick work. This will be very helpful. I'll be sure to use it gratefully.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Is there something else?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Yes. Before allowing you to use the permit, I would need you to agree to our condition first.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: We want you to tell us the route of entry you always took to sneak into the park.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's all?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: How do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I sneaked into the park and performed here without any sort of permission, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You may view me as part of the cast now, but I just can't believe that you wouldn't at least berate me a little for what I did.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I see what you mean now...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Please rest assured that as long as you reveal your route of entry to us, there will be no further repercussions.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: It is because Miss Emu needs you for her stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Needs me, huh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So they're really going to just let me off like that... It goes to show how much they treasure Emu.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Very well. I'll tell you how I got in. I do need to show my appreciation for your generous acceptance, after all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm going too!
I wanna see what Rui's secret pathway looks like too♪

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Then I'll join you...
I don't want to be left alone here with this guy...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: S-Say what?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Haha, she meant no offense.
She's just shy around people she's not familiar with.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Would a shy person even say such things?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then, how about all four of us go together? You should be able to handle that, right?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Here you go.
This was the bypath that I used.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line:
Right next to Wonder Stage...
Talk about a blind spot.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I must seal this place up for Miss Emu's safety. Excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: He left...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, then! It's time for us to do what we actually came here for!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone, take a look at this!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: A notebook?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It contains the plan for our future shows!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Plan?! As in plan your finances, right?!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I don't think he meant that sort of plan...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I can see you've given this quite a bit of thought.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmph! I get work done, and quickly!
That's why I'm me!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Hm... This is surprisingly deep planning coming from you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No need to mention you were surprised!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To pull out all the stops for a successful show is what we all ought to be doing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes... I agree.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's make this a great show together, Tsukasa.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Our recent show was a great success.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Many in the audience have said that they would like to watch it again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's great. I'm glad to hear everyone enjoyed themselves.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wonderhoy!
Seeing everyone smile was the best part☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I have an idea!
Let's perform every day so that we can make even more people smile!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Every day...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't think that's possible...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?! Why?!
You don't want to perform anymore?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's not why I said that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's just, we all have school, so it's not realistic for us to perform every day...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I was performing by myself every day before I joined this troupe, though.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, it won't be easy to get everyone to come here every day to perform together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If the quality of our performance drops as a result, that would do more harm than good as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I see... It's a shame we can't do it, but I understand.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Let's focus on doing weekend shows for now.
It's easier to attract an audience during that time period anyway.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Besides, we're still in the midst of figuring out what we can do with the number of people we have.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So let's just experiment on different things for now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Experiment...
You'd better not be having any funny ideas.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What sort of funny ideas are you thinking about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Simply put, human experimentation...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Putting aside whether you'll be experimented on...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't brush it off just like that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The thing is... If we're going to keep this stage going, we can't keep performing the same show all the time. What are we going to do about that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I already have something in mind.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll continue on with Pegasus Odyssey as our regular show, while preparing for a new script and show in between.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Preparing for a new show while performing regularly means it'll be a while before we can finish the new one, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I've thought about that too. We won't change the main plot of our regular show, but we can add impromptu lines and rearrange some scenes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This keeps the play fresh and will encourage the audience to come back repeatedly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good point! Shows with slight scene variations between their matinee and night performances do exist, after all!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad you're so quick on the uptake.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! We'll stick with that plan for now, then!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay. Now that we're agreed on the general direction to take for the near future, let's talk more about the specifics.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well then, why don't we decide on a practice schedule for our regular performances first?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Refining our basic performance would make it easier for us to ad-lib or add impromptu actions, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's true.
When is everyone free?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that our practice dates are settled, it's time for us to think about what to do for our next script!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
Does anyone already have something in mind?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me! Me!
I want to do a soft and fluffy show next!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's a very abstract description, as usual...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Soft and fluffy...
How about A Midsummer Night's Dream, then?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's a play by Shakespeare, right?
Which part of that play is soft or fluffy, though?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Every character in that play is soft, remember? In the head.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey now!
I mean, you're not wrong, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What's the story about?
Do you know, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes, but...
We can't do that play with just four people.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, that's where our most capable scriptwriter and superstar comes in, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You want me to adapt the play?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm just itching to put my stage direction into good use. How should I depict that midsummer night?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes... Whose head shall I turn into a donkey's?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When you're the one saying it, it's too real to be funny...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It sounds like so much fun! Let's do that!
I wanna be the soft and fluffy character!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You need to think before you speak!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I don't know what kind of shows this troupe will become capable of performing as we go along, but...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I hope our next performance will make everyone happy as well.
On a certain holiday
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that we've concluded our Halloween show with great success, it's time to start thinking about the direction for the next show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Though, that's actually more or less settled.
I guess the main issue is the wire-flying part...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We've been using it as a way to jump on the stage so far, but it may be interesting to add in some of those flying parts often seen at male idol shows.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It won't be free-form flying, but we can at least make it look like the character is flying out from the stage.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (What I'm concerned about is how that will appear to the audience seated in different positions. I'll need to coordinate it with the lighting as well.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Of course, there's also the matter of safety.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The more wires we use or the more people on the fly system, the higher the risk of entanglement and accidents.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But it creates a greater impact when multiple people do it. A scene like that would be unforgettable.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (For future applications, we should probably design the system to be able to accommodate multiple people.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm going to need to do more tests and verifications. Which means my next step will be...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui... We're here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, right. Robo-Nene's due for maintenance today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I was so engrossed in thinking about the next stage production that I'd forgotten about it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No problem. It wouldn't be the first time you've ever forgotten to eat or sleep because of that, anyway.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, you're absolutely right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then, let me get started on the maintenance now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, thanks. Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui, are these drawings on the table about the fly system we were talking about the other day?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We'll be incorporating that into the next show?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I haven't decided yet.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've yet to come up with firm plans that will ensure a good balance of visual presentation, lighting, and safety.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Safety...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you still feeling bad about what happened? That Tsukasa got injured.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It would be a lie for me to say that it doesn't bother me anymore, but this is somewhat different.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How is it different?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What you're worried about is whether I'm being overly affected by it, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then you can rest assured.
After all, thanks to you and Emu, I managed to talk things out with Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's just that, as a director, I should never take the actors on stage for granted.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Especially for someone like Tsukasa, who's willing to go along with anything I ask him to do.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see. So am I right to say you're just thinking ahead?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course you are.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad you're feeling yourself again, then.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright. That's all for Robo-Nene's maintenance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks. Well, I should head home now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, just a minute, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When I had that fight with Tsukasa, your suggestion to visit SEKAI really helped.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I definitely wouldn't have been able to resolve that problem on my own. So I appreciated that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, KAITO was the one who gave you the advice you needed, though.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Heheh. Still, if you hadn't made the suggestion, I would still be stuck in a rut of worries by myself right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's why I just wanted to say how grateful I am again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to see how you'll direct the next show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I promised Tsukasa and Emu too, after all. You can expect to see great things indeed.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hey, Tsukasa. Are you done there?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah. I lined it up properly with center stage!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thanks! Okay, this gives us the breadth of the stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We've also measured the depth and height.
Now for the number of illuminations.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: If you don't mind, I have a simple stage layout plan here that may help.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Old and malfunctioning lights have been marked with an X.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This...will be very helpful indeed. I do need all the information I can get on the facilities here for our next show, after all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Besides, there's a chance we may find some unused facilities, like the trap room we found during the Halloween show.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you have any other concerns about the stage facilities yourself, Mr. Mascot?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: No, I don't believe there are any issues with the lighting. If I had to mention something, though, it would have to be the audience seats.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Why are you concerned about the audience seats?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line:
They're in quite bad shape.
We did some minor repairs previously, but not every issue has been addressed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right. Some of them are wobbly and not comfortable to sit in. We should really do something about that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's dangerous and needs to be fixed!
Mascot, you have to help us!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Yes, Miss Emu. It may take some time, but I will certainly make the necessary arrangements.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Thank you, Mr. Mascot!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad we have such a competent mascot on board.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, while we're fixing the seats, is it possible for us to tweak them a little as well?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: How do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm thinking of installing a compact device to each seat that allows for theatrical effects using water and wind.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Water and wind effects? How does that work?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe you can think of them as something like 4D effects.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The last time the seats were repaired, I know we were told it's not quite possible to make the seats move...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What about modifying the seats to be able to vibrate, blow gusts of wind, spray water, or emit odors?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If we can achieve that, it would completely differentiate us from the other stages here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ohh! That sounds fabulous!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: What size of device are we talking about here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Small enough to fit under the audience seat. Grand-looking devices won't fit the theme of this stage, anyway, and it's easier to control a device that's simple and compact.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I see... In that case, there's probably no need to notify headquarters about it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You mean, there are cases where we may need to do that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't remember notifying them about the pop-up device we installed for the previous show...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: That's because we settled that for you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. You're really reliable.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Speaking of which, we need to send them a report about the device's state of maintenance and functionality soon.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, is that right? That's perfect, actually.
I'll do the maintenance check right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means...you're up, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, is your safety harness properly attached?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes...but are you really sure this is going to be safe?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've been maintaining it regularly, so I don't think there will be any major safety issues.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Besides, I've added a practice mat like you suggested, so it should be even safer now. In fact, let's go for the highest output setting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Highest output? Why does that sound so cool?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? As usual, I'm having a bad feeling about this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What a coincidence because so am I...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then, Tsukasa. Break through the laws of gravity and become the star you've always wanted to be!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait a minute. You're not seriously going to launch me up that high...are you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Five seconds to liftoff.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: 1. Fire!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: GAAAAH?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooow! Tsukasa's flying so high!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Whoa... That's so height.
This isn't a pop-up device anymore. More like a catapult, if you ask me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Angle and height of flight are just as I've predicted. There's no wind to affect the trajectory either. Mascots, the mat, please.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Already standing by.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Rui, Rui! I wanna go next!
I wanna become a twinkle twinkle little star, too!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: N-No, please! Miss Emu, do not involve yourself with this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aww, why not?! It looks so fun and exciting!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: NAAAAARRRG...bugh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-What in the... This mat is amazing!
I didn't feel any pain at all even after falling from that height!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Instead, when I landed, it almost felt as if I was being enveloped by a gentle embrace!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now I can literally be the brightest star in the sky!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like we even managed to accidentally test out the performance of the new mat as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well now... I've collected plenty of useful data today thanks to everyone's help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think we may even be able to test out a few other things that we've been skipping over so far.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Urgh, as exciting as you're making it sound, why can't I seem to suppress this sense of dread from welling up?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Well, just look forward expectantly to what I have in store.
Hehehe...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Now, what should I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I feel like the onus is on me to come up with a way to break this impasse, both as the show director and as Nene's friend...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But Seiryuin's singing is... Just so different. I can tell because I've spent so much time learning about songs from musicals.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know how to put it in words, but she has a way of breathing life into each note. I don't know what I'm supposed to do about that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (A way of breathing life into each note, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She does indeed have a strong and rich singing voice...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And yet, I don't think Nene's lacking at all in that respect.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It may be that Nene just simply lacks confidence, not skill...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But this is a tough one... A person's impressions regarding something can't be changed too easily...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So how do I go about boosting Nene's confidence?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Or rather, stop her from thinking that she's missing something...?)
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, what should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Where was I...?
Ah, yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A person's impressions regarding something can't be changed too easily...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So she just needs something that can boost her confidence...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hmm... Her memories, how she used to feel...
Something immediately recognizable...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, that's it!
I think I found the solution!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That is a surefire way to convince her.
It should still be with the old recordings...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Here it is. Let's see if it still plays...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is it. A video of Nene's very first musical performance...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She gave it to me as reference material, but I'm glad I kept it all these years.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She was playing a cheerful little girl in this one, but she genuinely sang from her heart.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (You can hear her unbridled enjoyment of the show in her voice.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This performance secured her a lead role in her next show, but then she had that accident...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I can't remember my next line!
What should I do? What should I do!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I only heard about it from someone else much later and still don't know any other details behind it...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(But it might still be haunting Nene.
Keeping her from unleashing her potential...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This may very well be the reason why she can't sing like she used to...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But should I really be the one to tell her?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (If I did, she'd finally be able to address it. But at the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is telling her this really the right thing to do...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is this honestly what you want from this show?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you feel that if things continue like this, we won't be able to put on a worthwhile show, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You can't make great shows alone...
And now I have my troupe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'll tell Nene my thoughts tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I believe that if we work together, we'll have a bright future in front of us.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Our Christmas show can use some more polishing too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
There's plenty of time until morning.
Let's see how we can tweak it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It has the be the ultimate show after all.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All of our Christmas show performances were a smash hit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With that now behind us, we should start thinking of our next show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. The next show for the contest is important, but if we're to do it in parallel with our regular shows, we have to get a head start.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, then our meeting today can be about strategizing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. But I also have an announcement to make first.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: An announcement?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We've taken part in two rounds of this contest, spanning the period from Halloween until Christmas...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I've been keeping a close eye on our rivals throughout this time too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, how...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good job, Rui!
So you've got some intel for us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I do. After seeing other contestants' performances, I've arrived upon what our two greatest strengths are.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Oh! And...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The first one is the novelty Wonderlands×Showtime brings.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Novelty?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Have you seen what kinds of shows the other troupes in the park are doing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, some of them... The ones at the Hero Stage have been about superheroes who defend the park against villains by challenging them to games and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: At the Mascot Stage, they've been doing stories about Phenny!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Exactly, so consider this. Have you ever seen a show that wasn't about superheroes at the Hero Stage?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Or a show that didn't feature mascots, like Phenny, at the Mascot Stage?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, of course not.
They have to stick with their themes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Most of the other Phoenix Wonderland troupes always do shows revolving around their respective themes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As a result, the scope of their performances predictably becomes limited.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
On the other hand, we're the newcomers.
And we're not bound to any specific theme.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah, I see. No one expects us to do only certain shows, so we can switch between different genres as we like, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, precisely! You see how this plays to our advantage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our second greatest strength is individuality as our troupe is full of distinctive personalities.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
In other words...
We're a bunch of weirdos.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait... Why are you staring at me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No reason...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. The other troupes have a singular, star performer, such as Sakurako from Phoenix Stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And naturally, their shows are all designed to have their respective stars be in the limelight.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But theatrical shows are supposed to focus on the lead actor or actress, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, of course. But in the case of our rivals, they always cast the same players as their leads.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On top of that, those roles are often very similar, or part of a series of shows where the leads are always playing the same characters.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words, there's no variety.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait... But don't we always have the same cast for every show?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, but our roles are much more diverse.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa sometimes plays two or even three different parts.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And each role is quite different from the other.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's also not forget that we had two leads in our Christmas show with Tsukasa and Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can easily see you in a lead role too, Emu, with your rich expressions and talent for acrobatics.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe any one of us from Wonderlands×Showtime has the potential to be a brilliant lead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. Us being such a motley crew does give us a sort of unique advantage.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We have the freedom to switch things up so that our plays never become stale, and we can tackle any genre.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! The Wonder Stage can be a window into unlimited fantastic worlds for everyone to enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And that's precisely what we set out to do when we decided to become Wonderlands×Showtime...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right. Staying true to that will definitely give us an edge in the contest too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah. It's important to have a goal to stick to...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, that was a rather long preamble to my vision for our next show. I would like it to be based on these two strengths: novelty and personality.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too! Me too!
Hehehe. I'm so excited about this♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! Then let's come up with a story for our new show that takes our strengths into account!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Let's make our next show one for the ages. Together.
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, let's GO GO GO to the next area♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu's having so much fun guiding them around.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She already seemed to know them and must have really wanted to show them this place.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But you're not having a bad time yourself, are you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well... I suppose not...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui! Nene! Hurry up or you'll get left behind!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, alright.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. We rarely get this sort of chance,
so we should probably make the most of it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our next attraction is the Phoenix Coaster...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's so tall... And it looks really fast...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed it does! The Go! Go! Phenny! coaster we rode earlier is very family-oriented, but this one is geared more towards thrill-seeking youngsters!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since its upgrade, it's become one of the biggest draws for this park!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hang on, that's pretty much exactly what the pamphlet for this place said...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hnng...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Allow me to elaborate further...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The lights on the coaster change with each season.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And since it's much taller than the Phenny coaster, the view from the top is supposed to be spectacular, especially at night.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The camera at the peak is set up so that it captures the best possible angle and background as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What's more, photos are taken not only from the front, but also from behind as you descend for a more dynamic image.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's how you do it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You... You know your stuff, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Each of this park's attractions has its own charm.
I researched them all as references for later.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was wondering what Tsukasa's troupe would be like, but they all seem much more capable than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. Rui probably does a lot to keep Tsukasa's crazy ideas in check too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see. Kamishiro must really understand him then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Next is... Ah, of course! We should show you some interesting locations alongside the rides and attractions!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I've got this☆ Let me take over, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
If you stroll down to the right of this road,
you'll find a quiet little path with a bench.
It's a lovely spot to sit down and relax♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe... And let's not forget the Phenny monument that's cleverly placed at the beginning of the path.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, so it's a spot for taking pictures but a little tucked away?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it's quite photogenic.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the best part is how it makes for such great cover.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's the perfect spot to hide from the park's security guards. They never look behind the monument.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Umm, so...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, right! It's because Rui kept getting in trouble with the guards for doing shows in the park without permission♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh yeah, he used to do that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why'd you pick this theme park for that anyway, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I was drawn here simply by how many visitors the park attracts.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Emu and the others don't seem bothered by it, so maybe it's not as strange as it seems?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uhh, sure...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! Next, we have a ride that takes you through a torrential downpour and gale-force winds!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That is a good one, and very realistic too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Although, if you were to ask me, it lacks lightning bolts like the ones we featured in one of our shows.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: L-Lightning...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I remember that... I was SHOCKED that we actually did that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It was sooo amazing!
All ZINGY ZING and ZAP ZAP ZAP!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Not only did it give me terrible frizz,
some of my hair actually got singed...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, this isn't a joke? It really happened?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Rui's really good at coming up with stage effects♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And he makes cool stuff like Robo-Nene and other robots!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki, Shiho, & Honami
rows.Line: R-Robots?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. You'll see some at today's show.
Maybe you can see them afterwards as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: W-We'll be looking forward to it...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It sounds just... Unbelievable, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is all just going way over my head...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha... Well, I guess in the end, he is someone that can actually make shows really happen with my brother.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...  And maybe a little out of the ordinary in this case is just par for the course.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. They all look like they're having fun,
so I guess that's what matters!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's give today's rehearsal everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's do our best, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Why the heavy sigh?
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um...
Well, it's about Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ichika?
You're friends with her now too, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess we are...
But we didn't exchange contact info or anything...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You didn't?
You'll have to ask her next time you see her.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ichika's not exactly the most outgoing type either from what I remember.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How terrible would it be if your budding friendship withered before ever having a chance to blossom!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nooo! You can't let that happen!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene! She goes to the same school as me!
I can ask her about it tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait... Emu, I...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's sort of my fault, so I don't want to ask someone else to make things right in my place.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She asked you to help her with her singing, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In which case, I'm sure she'll try to contact you at some point, so there's no need to get so anxious.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... But...

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: Neneee!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Nene, it's Rin!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh... I'll be back in a bit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, Emu, can I ask you a favor?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
About Nene...
I was thinking we could help her a little.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Help her how?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For example, by canceling tomorrow's rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Fortunately, we have plenty of time to prepare for the next part of the contest, so skipping one rehearsal won't exactly be detrimental.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, okay. That's fine by me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But what if Nene doesn't take advantage of this opportunity to get her contact information?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That part will be up to her.
Nonetheless, we can still do our part.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Rui! Tsukasa! Let's do this!
Operation Securing Nene & Ichika's Friendship!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, why me too?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Then let's begin by telling Nene that we can't make it to tomorrow's rehearsal.
After school the next day
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Who'd have thought Rin would suggest to Nene that she should go ask Ichika for her number without us having to do anything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah. She just parted the waters for her.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But how do we make sure Nene goes through with obtaining Ichika's information?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We won't see what's going on unless we get close, but if we do, she'll spot us right away and it'll be game over...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't worry, I've thought of everything.
First, we go towards that bush over there.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, okay.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm... This should be the right place...
Psst! Tsukasa! Rui! Over here...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu?! Why were you hiding in there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is a secret shortcut into the school's courtyard! I found it while exploring the grounds right after my first day!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This way, we get to walk right up to the gate without being seen.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, let's see if Nene can pull through for us.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Looks like it went well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Nicely done, Nene. I'm glad it worked out...)

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Neneee!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
E-Emu?! Wait, you guys are here too?!
No, don't tell me you saw everything?!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu really just left.
I wonder if she's okay...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: With her gone, we can't actually do any talking.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I suppose we should call it a day as well then...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, excuse me. I think I left something at the Wonder Stage...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, would you mind going ahead without me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Uh, sure...? I'll be fine by myself.
Bye.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'll see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now...
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, Mr. Mascot.
What a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line:
Why are you still here?
I thought that you had all left by now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I forgot something here is all.
Would you mind helping me?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: If I may, what is it that you've forgotten?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? I was under the impression that you were surveilling me.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Unfortunately, here I am a mascot and not a person.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nonetheless, there's no time to waste so I'll get right to it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you know why Emu and her brothers were having such a fierce argument?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What is she hiding from us?
Why won't she tell us anything?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Ah, so you did lose quite a few things...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I did. However, they're very valuable to me, so I would very much like to find them... How about it?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I cannot say.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, but were you not there with her?
You are her bodyguard after all...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Under normal circumstances, you wouldn't sit idly by if someone raised their voices at her in that manner.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then how about this?
Allow me to tell a little story...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In truth, I am incredibly thankful for Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Her determination to save the Wonder Stage and her will to not give up allowed me to meet the wonderful people I am with now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And we're able to put on shows that deliver smiles to countless people.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I... No, we, as Wonderlands×Showtime, want to keep putting on the best shows possible, together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why if anything that would rob us of that opportunity were to arise, I will refuse to simply let it happen.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I will not let my friends be openly insulted either. Even if it's Emu's family we're dealing with.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So I'll ask once more.
What is going on with Emu?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I cannot say...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I am in no position to speak on Ms. Emu's behalf if she wishes to not speak about something herself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Well, that may be so...
And I apologize for prying.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alas, as much information as I can obtain will also suffice. Would you at least be able to tell me something that does not necessarily go against what Emu believes?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then that is all for me...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I... We, the mascots, are under the employ of Ms. Emu's father...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: So we are not in the position to support her ideas as such...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... You risk termination by biting the hand that feeds you, yes?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Indeed. However, we also cannot leave her side at a time like this.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: We can at least say that we appreciate you supporting her fight against her brothers...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, of course. She's a valued friend and troupe member.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: At the moment, I have no information to give you...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: But if the time comes when Emu does decide to open up to you...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Then we will also vow to support her in her quest... Now, if you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... So we'll need to talk to Emu first before anything else can happen?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But based on the interaction I just had, this is hardly going to be easy...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll have to discuss this with Tsukasa and Nene once more as well...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So can you please tell us what took away that smile of yours?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And let's try to figure something out together.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone, thank you...
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (A few days have passed since then, but Emu's brothers are yet to make a clear move...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Nonetheless, we must remain on guard. We'll need to keep polishing our idea as well.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, Tsukasa! Let's try to figure out what kind of butterfly this caterpillar will turn into!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Eeeek...! Please, don't come near me!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What the...?! No, don't come this way! I have nothing to do with this...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! You can help too, Nene♪
What kind of butterfly will it turn into?!

rows.Speaker: Nene & Tsukasa
rows.Line: Noooo!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Sigh*... J-Just put it back where you found it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Let's play again Mr. Caterpillar!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-We made it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... Rui, you could've helped us!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, my apologies. You just seemed to be having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It looks like she's back to her usual self, but doesn't something still seem a little off...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I feel like she hasn't been adding Yahohoy! or Zoom! or any other nonsensical words to her sentences lately...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, that's what you're worried about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I see... Some time did pass before we heard her trademark Wonderhoy! again as well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly. The last time she said that was... When we all put our hands together and shouted that on stage, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, she always said stuff like that every day...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes... Well, this is just me speculating but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She has a tendency to emote using her unique vocabulary when she feels absolutely compelled to do so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Wait, that means she...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hasn't been able to feel that way lately. She may be choosing her words more carefully than normal.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So she still has something bottled up inside her?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe we should just let her be? I mean, we just sort of vowed to work together so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But...
If she really isn't able to genuinely enjoy anything, then we might need to intervene...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Then why don't we put on a special show that'll make her smile no matter what as a present!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa! Nene! I said goodbye to Mr. Caterpillar... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait... We just cleaned up the stage, so why's there a pop-out up there now?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The inaugural... Don't Let the Demon Lord Escape Game Tournament!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Demon lord? Game?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is a game that we've been planning for a while, but we thought that you should be the one to test it out, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In a nutshell... You, Emu, the hero will have to keep the evil Demon Lord Tsukasa, who's been cornered, from escaping your grasp.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! That sounds fun♪
How do I stop him?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To do that, you'll need to use the ten Demon Lord buttons here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Each will unleash a kind of magical trickery that will keep Tsukasa from escaping.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You win when he gives into these tricks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But there are also buttons that can help the evil Demon Lord Tsukasa escape, so make sure not to press those.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Got it♪
Oh, but where's Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's standing ready by that pop-out.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Oh, also. Nene! Rui! Are we gonna use this in a show too?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll have to make a few adjustments, but that would be nice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And this is a valuable test for making that happen, so we'll be counting on you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Wait, Rui! About that magical trickery you were talking about... What exactly does that involve? Just no bug toys or anything falling on me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Using the same thing over and over again makes it stale. This just involves dumping water, pepper or flour on you, so I wouldn't worry.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez... No thanks...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's begin! Now, Emu, our hero...! Please choose a button from these ten to press!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Here we go♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Hm... Uhh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, Rui...! A Styrofoam snow man just came down...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Depending on the button, many more will come crashing down, so I thought they should be nice to at least look at.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, and the water will fall during the real thing in such a way that you won't get wet.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
I see. In that case...
Wait... During the real thing?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Which one should I press♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
How about this, Emu?
What do you want to see the most?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, water would make him cold, so that might be mean. But pepper might be fun☆ Sneezing all achoo, achoo♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: If you feel so bad for me, you can press the button that lets me go...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Then the evil Demon Lord will escape...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! What's this one?!
Go♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: No, wait! I forgot that the pop-out could start moving too. Before you press anything, give me a chance to get ready!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll do a countdown☆
Here we go, Tsukasa...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: 3, 2... Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... She said, Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. I didn't expect her to say that there but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, this is... A-Achoo! Achoo! Aaachooo!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Tsukasa can't stop sneezing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then it might be nice for him to rinse that off with some nice water, no?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! You're right☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
Achoo...! Huh? No!
Press the escape button... Achoo!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heehee♪ Which button makes the water go splash☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We may've gone a little overboard, but I think she's finally returning to her usual self...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. I think she'll be just fine now.
Hiking Trail

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The park knows about the sign back there now, so all that's left to do is...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think we're finally getting a break from the rain. We should probably head down before it starts up again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But those two girls back there...
I swear I've seen them before...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which two girls?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh! I remember now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Airi Momoi and Shizuku Hinomori!
They're both idols, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Idols?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I've seen them on TV before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, are they famous?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I guess you wouldn't know, Rui. You've never been interested in music shows or celebrity news and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You have me there... Oh, would you look at that...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Finally, found you! E-Excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you for helping us out back there! You really saved us!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You came all this way to tell us that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We wanted to thank you sooner, but were still pretty flustered about what just happened.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you very much for what you did.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... We just happened to be passing by and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And that led to you saving us.
We can't thank you enough!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Th-They really are idols...
It's like they actually have this sort of shine or sparkle to them...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But what about Mizuki...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(After we saved everyone,
Mizuki looked ecstatic...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(But I sensed it before at school...
Maybe something is wrong...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We should get back soon. I think we've made the other people on this tour wait long enough already.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That may've been a mistake...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Staring at Mizuki like that probably triggered a few alarm bells. I may not be able to ask what's the matter now...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, we'll be heading off now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Bye bye♪
Later, Rui...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'll see you at school.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui? Is something about Akiyama bothering you...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, no. It's nothing.
Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why? Because you had this really serious expression on your face just now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Mizuki's smile just now... Maybe it wasn't an act. What if it was for me...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Look at us. You're worried about me while I'm worried about Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You are? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not sure. That's partly what concerns me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You've known Akiyama since junior high, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you sure you don't want to go and say something?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure. I'd be causing the rest of the group trouble, and I can just try asking about it at school.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, if you say so...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I appreciate your concern, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shall we head home now?
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Drone
rows.Line: *Whirr*...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not seeing any people on this screen...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Looks like I struck out again today. To be fair, Mizuki hardly ever comes to school to begin with...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But this may also work in my favor. It gives me time to work on that as well...
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, that should be enough for today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Great work, everyone!
Hehe☆ Another wonderhoy practice♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
By the way, Tsukasa...
Would you mind staying back a little while longer?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Sure, are you thinking about doing another test?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait... You're not making him test that power armor or whatever, are you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
P-Power armor?!
What's that?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. I'd like to tell you more, but it unfortunately still requires quite a bit of adjusting. I'll explain when it's ready to be brought here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For now, I'd like you to try something else out, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I am interested in this power armor of yours, but go right on ahead. I'm sure it has something to with our show, so I'll help in any way I can...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, this sounds fun♪
Let's watch to see what happens, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure, why not? It's not like I have anything to do after this anyway.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, what do you need me to do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd like to record your voice, Tsukasa. Just a series of short lines to start, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Recordings of someone as obnoxious as him? What do you plan on using those for?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you mean by obnoxious?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: See? Case and point...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'll use them in a show of course.
They'll serve as props.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've even thought of several uses for them too. My favorite so far is emulating instant transmission...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Instant transmission?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is that even possible on a stage like this?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I believe so. The first thing I'd like to try is something very simple and traditional.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We can place these away from the stage and play them to draw attention away from the stage. We can appear or disappear in that moment...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That just feels like a cheap trick, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, it'll also depend on exactly how we implement them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For now, I'd like a few samples that I can use to test the acoustics around here and just simply hear how it sounds.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can do that. Just tell me what to say!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, there's something else I'd also like to do with this, so would you mind ad-libbing a few lines for me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If possible, something that might make the person listening to this laugh. Would you mind?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You should say, Wonderhoy!
Rui, can I see your script☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, what?! Don't just add lines like that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, what if he said some stuff he normally wouldn't? Something like, Razzle Dazzle Sunny Funny☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Excellent! The more the merrier!
We can include both of those!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Have you not been listening to a word I've said...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... Okay, is that everything?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That should do it. Thank you very much, Tsukasa! You gave me a very...interesting sampling.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All that's left is to activate the randomizer function, and version 1.0 is complete...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Already?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, this button looks really tempting too!
Wait, is this...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is this that toy you talked about making back during the Doll Festival?! The one that speaks when you press its button?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, exactly! I'd already been thinking about how to make something like this when I last mentioned it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We can start testing it right now.
Emu, if you'll do the honors...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Tenma, written as soaring pegasus!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It sounds better than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I wanna hear some more♪
Bam bam bam!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: ＜His name is...!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <A hundred million light years more!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Whaaat?!>
