rows.Speaker: Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The randomizer's working very well too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh, did you really have to program that in?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. Just listen...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <The one destined to become a star! His name is...!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Razzle Dazzle Sunny Funny☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hahaha! You're too funny, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
E-Emu, stop...
My sides... I'm laughing too hard...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So you really think this is going to be useful...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe that being able to relax and enjoy life like this is just as important as coming up with ideas for our shows.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I suppose you're right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As I mentioned before, I'd like to use this for something other than out shows as well. Would that be alright with you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Like I said, I think being able to smile and laugh without a second thought is important sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Does that mean there's someone you want to help cheer up?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, there is... An old friend of mine...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, go right on ahead!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're sure?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now you're hesitating?
Go! Help your friend out!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, I won't accept anything less than them bursting into tears laughing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Thank you, Tsukasa...
Wedding Ceremony Hall

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, that should be it for our final checks...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yay! I'm glad we made it in time for the actual wedding!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All that's left for us is to wait for it to start.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! I hope everything goes well!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, so do I.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The proposal scene and the dance after that should be all set to go too...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Everybody here wants our performance and this ceremony to succeed.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm sure it'll go well...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (No, I need to keep doing what I can to guarantee success. One last check...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Um, Rui...?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Uh... Are you getting nervous, maybe?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me? Nervous?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I see. I may be getting a little nervous...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's been quite a while since I last did a show with people outside of Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Maybe not since that one time...)

What the... I'm not doing something that dumb.
Don't you have any better ideas?
Are you having a laugh trying to get us hurt?
I've had enough of you and your stupid shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was under the impression that nobody else would understand what I was hoping to achieve and had to do it all myself...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At least, that was what I thought back then.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I have Tsukasa and the others now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're willing to go along with my ideas as long as we can make our audiences smile and laugh.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's why I've been able to put on the shows that I've been truly wanting to. It's all thanks to them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But when I'm working with complete strangers...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You were worried about what would happen. You weren't sure if they would accept your ideas...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. That may've caused me to hesitate somewhat.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I wasn't the only one doing something they're not used to doing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In particular, Aoyagi, since he said it was the first time he's had to sing while acting at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He definitely seemed like more of the quiet type and not one to talk to people he doesn't really know.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yet he was willing to talk to me and the other objectors for the sake of this ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Someone in my family thinks in sort of the same way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't understand what he was doing at first. It puzzled me how he could torment a family member over such a thing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But now I understand a little.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe that Akito decided to help us because he came to an understanding that your way would work in this case.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There are certain things that we aren't willing to compromise on as well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He likely felt some weight in terms of having to replace Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But his modesty and hard-working honesty have been invaluable.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm glad he's here today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We should head back now. We'll need to keep making sure everything is ready as time permits.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Hey, Rui, wait...!
Look, it's them.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Honestly, I just can't figure out what Kamishiro's thinking...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I do know that he's serious about making all these people happy with his show.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I feel like I'm being played by him...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I said I'll help, so I'm giving it everything I've got. No ifs, ands or buts...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That's great, Rui!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm glad they're both here today.)
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey! I'm here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, that makes everyone.
Let's get started with practice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, there's a video I want to show you guys first! One of my friends from class told me about it...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, is that...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's... That's... Nooo! That's the show I was supposed to be a part of!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Keep it down...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. You were supposed to be an extra for a wedding, right, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was, but something unfortunate happened. I had a friend of mine go in my place...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Something unfortunate?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He had food poisoning, so Aoyagi ended up taking his place.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, Aoyagi as in the one from my class...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shinonome came to help as well. Even one of the hall monitors joined in at the last minute.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, maybe they're in the video too!
What do they look like?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Lemme see... No, I don't think they're in this shot.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's too bad...
But I didn't know that they were your friends, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Friends? I mean, we've talked a little before...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I already thanked them when we were at school, but I still need to pay them back someday!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, but you've known Aoyagi for a while now, right, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Aoyagi seems to be one of Tsukasa's biggest fans. It's curious how he ended up having to take his place for this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He did very well for himself too. His hard-working attitude was a real lifesaver.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A lifesaver? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa actually asked me to go check on him and the overall situation.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I remember from the night festival that he was quite the singer, but then I learned that he didn't have any acting experience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: More things came up after that and I ended up having to direct the whole performance...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?! You're saying that you did all this?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Well, the groundwork was already laid out. All I did was make a few adjustments.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I didn't know that! Did you come up with the bang-zoom-boom part in the end too, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Correct! Well done, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay☆ I got it right♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hold on...
They were okay with all of that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As you can see, everything was a big success. I could not ask for a happier crowd...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I got that much, but that's not what I'm talking about...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What I mean is, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You haven't done anything like this with other people in a really long time, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I appreciate your concern.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I know full well that not all of my ideas will pan out. I understand that they're not for everyone and some even openly disagreed with me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still don't like the way you do things, Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I know that feeling of wanting to make something happen no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When everyone realized that we were doing it all for the bride and the groom, they became much more understanding and gave it their best.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I learned that it's important to have a common goal to work towards despite any differences we may have.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then good for you, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nonetheless, I still have much to learn, and my mistakes from then will surely help us later on.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. Don't get so down now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're Wonderlands×Showtime! We're the ones that give your shows 20,000%!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, another unprovable claim? That value's grown since last time as well, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's because we have Emu and Nene now! Of course it's gone up!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I see.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui, just tell us what you want us to do and we'll do it☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't have superpowers like these two, so don't forget to go easy on me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I will. Thank you, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I couldn't ask for more...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I have to keep doing everything I can as a director too.)
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, let's go over what was have so far.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For our first assignment as ambassadors, we'll be performing a show on the seaside stage owned by this hotel affiliate.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And our show will center on a Little Mermaid theme.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't wait to see how our show turns out! Right, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. It might be a little tough being our first assignment and all, but I'm sure we'll manage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly! As ambassadors, there's nowhere else to go but forward!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I sensed some nerves while we were brainstorming yesterday...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I believe we'll be just fine now.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The future of Phoenix Wonderland depends on how we do!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Thanks to Project Wonder's success, we were able to reestablish Phoenix Wonderland's reputation as a place that makes everyone smile.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And moving forward, we'll have to keep working to make sure it stays that way.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that, the other troupes and staff were really the ones who made Project Wonder possible. The park means just that much to them as well.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So let's start putting together a show worthy of us, the right honorable representatives of Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So where do we start?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We shouldn't have to deviate from our usual routine much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll write a script, throw in some effects, gather any necessary props and equipment, and rehearse.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, really?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was sure that we'll need to do lots of extra stuff since we're gonna be performing on a stage that we've never been to before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it is important to keep in mind that we'll be performing at a new venue.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Especially since we won't have much time to practice or rehearse before we go live.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, we won't?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Apparently, it's a very popular stage. From what I understand, it's all booked up for the summer.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I have been able to confirm that we'll have time to rehearse the day of, so we have some room for error.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That means we'll have to practice here until then.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it does. The other stage's dimensions will differ from ours as well, so we'll need to be mindful of that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Does that also mean we won't really know what this stage looks like until we get there?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu's brothers were kind enough to send me some blueprints for the stage, so we'll have that to work with.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, that's good to know.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That just leaves...
The weather since it's an outdoor stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Which is something we have no control over...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aww, it'll be so sad if it rained.
Everybody would be too glub-glub frowny-face to come and see us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wouldn't our show get canceled before anyone has a chance to feel that way?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, that'd be even worse!
I'll start making weather charms today to guarantee that we get good weather!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't have a problem with being superstitious, but do those really work?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... Worst case scenario, if it does rain, We'll just have to launch Tsukasa into the sky to clear away the rain clouds for us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Rui, don't say that like it's a matter of fact.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. But don't you think it would be a magnificent spectacle to behold?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You know we're a theatre troupe and not a circus, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But a show's a show.
I actually have some other ideas if you don't mind hearing me out.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Oh! I wanna hear them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Fine, whatever.
It's not like I'm the one who has to be your stuntman.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! No!
Don't let Rui off his leash!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have more important things to talk about! Like how to make our next show more interesting!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, that's a shame.
But I suppose you're right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shall we start hammering out the details for our show?
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Finally, we're back!
Home stage home!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We were only gone a few days, but this stage is strangely comforting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The Beach Stage was really fun, but this is still the most wonderhoy stage of them all!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, I know that we're all very tired, but we should start putting away all our props and equipment.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's get to it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There! That should be everything!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For the rest of the day, you're all to get some well-deserved rest!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You know, I wouldn't mind practicing a little right now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez, does your battery ever run out?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, we can't lose focus just because we're back at our home stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This assignment isn't over until we are all back home.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So make sure to look both ways when you reach a sidewalk, and double-check again before you cross!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're not little kids, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I will keep you safe, Nene!

rows.Line:
Anyway, we'll see you tomorrow.

Neighborhood

rows.Line: *Yawn*... I'm getting sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Shall I carry you, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, but that would be way too embarrassing.

rows.Speaker: Child's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, a robot!

rows.Line: I know her! I saw her at Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: Whoa, that's so cool! She looks just like you! Are you twins or something?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh, well...

rows.Line:
I was made to look just like Nene.
That is why we look so similar.

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Cool, it talked!
You can sing too, right? Please, just one song?

rows.Line:
What are you still doing out?
I told you to come straight home!

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Aww...

rows.Line:
Beep... Of course!
Please make sure to come and visit again.

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
I will!
I promise to go back! Bye!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Face-to-face conversations still aren't your thing, are they? Even though you improvised so well during our show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: B-Because it just happened so fast...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks, Robo-Nene.
You really saved me just now.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: You're welcome, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now we're being recognized outside of the park and not just inside.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This never really happened before, did it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I feel like a lot of little kids are starting to recognize us more and more.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, she's always been like a kid magnet. Once they spot her, they run right towards her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And their parents were usually there to stop them before anything happened.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, that seems pretty natural. Most people don't usually see robots walking around town.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But that's starting to change.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thanks to the shows we've been doing at the Wonder Stage, as well as Project Wonder, Robo-Nene herself has become a staple attraction.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Does that mean I have become a valued member of the Wonder Stage troupe?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, it does.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I hope your fame keeps growing moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Moving forward...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I started wondering about the future while I was talking to her. About us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I plan on figuring out what's truly best for me and what I really want to do on my own.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only are others viewing us differently, but we're also starting to see ourselves differently.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But she doesn't seem worried at all.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(She even said so herself.
We each need to figure out what's truly best for us.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still... The future, huh?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (For as long as I've known her, Nene's always respected my dreams.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And she may still have trouble interacting with strangers, she's doing her best to move forward.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (You've come such a long way, Nene.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (While I...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (No, I'm finally able to spread my wings as a director because I met Tsukasa and Emu and formed Wonderlands×Showtime with them...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We're making shows that make everyone smile.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I know that for a fact, but...)

rows.Speaker: Old Classmates
rows.Line: I'm not doing this just because you think it's fun!

rows.Speaker: Old Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah! What's wrong with you, Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui? Why are you sighing...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, it's nothing.
At least, that's what I'd like to say. I suppose I'm more exhausted than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. We did just come back from a pretty crazy trip. I might collapse on my bed when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure I can fall asleep in less than a second right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Then let's go home and get in some well-deserved rest.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On behalf of Wonderlands×Showtime, thank you all for coming to see our show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's a wrap! Another show completely squared away without any trouble whatsoever!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and I have all of you to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nonsense. Your safety measures are what make our shows possible, no?

rows.Line: Yeah! Every time you come up with a new effect or some other amazing thing, you always make sure to tell us what's gonna happen!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. Some other amazing thing?
You could do it a little more justice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But that's the truth! It's always something super amazing♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Like the one that went WHOOSH-BOING-THUNK! That was so much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, from our second assignment as ambassadors. That was one of my best works yet.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How did he get all that from “whoosh”?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Who knows?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Regardless, Rui's fantastical ideas are one of our troupe's greatest selling points!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have to think that you're the only one out there who can come up with such zany ideas.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you. I'm honored.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I suspect that there are plenty of others out there who are just as creative or interesting as me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can name two at the very least.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I can guess who one is.
That director you really respect, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Correct.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <I'm constantly searching for new ideas and new challenges to take on. I refuse to be trapped inside a box...>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <However, there is something that I always keep in mind.>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <That is to “see beyond the fence”...>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <It doesn't matter if you're rich or poor, clever or foolish, among the majority or minority...>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <All people laugh, cry and feel anger in the same way...>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <That is what ties us all together after bearing witness to a truly marvelous spectacle.>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <My goal is to keep making shows that do just that.>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <I believe that is the key to humanity becoming one... I believe that there's something unimaginable special awaiting us at the end of that path!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Rui, does that mean the other person you were talking about is...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, the French novelist who's widely regarded as the father of science fiction...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: His stories about discovering an underground world at the center of the Earth, exploring lost civilizations in a submarine and flying to the moon immediately come to mind...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The sheer realism grounded in actual science made many of his fans believe that they were true tales.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's still well known to this day since his works have been adapted into movies and even theme park attractions.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! He must've been an incredible person!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Incidentally, I was introduced to his works just as I was starting to see how fun shows are.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My scientific curiosity even compelled me to come up with my own hypotheses regarding what he wrote.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: His story about a man being sent to the moon via a cannon was definitely my favorite growing up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... Is that why you're so obsessed with launching me into the air...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I've never thought of it that way...
I was under the impression that you were meant to soar through the sky...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm joking.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'm not lying about not thinking about it that way. At least, not consciously.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I read that book so many times that it began to fall apart, so a part of me must've been wanting to send you to the moon a la the protagonist.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He seems serious. Am I missing something...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, this is just who he is.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup♪
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... I could've sworn that I left it around here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Aha, found it. “From the Earth to the Moon”...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. All that time I spent when I was little trying to figure out how to adapt this novel for the stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And that one quote of his was something that I took to heart...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Anything one man can imagine, other men can make real.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: His stories were all about getting humanity to believe in what's possible by working together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I worked so hard to get my classmates to help me with my shows all those years ago...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Other men can make real...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I took that too seriously back then and flew too close to the sun. As a result, I ended up all alone.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Now I have...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? What's this...?
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was sure that I was being called over here. I guess that's not the case.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? What's that over there...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A ball of light...?
Is this a prop for one of KAITO's shows?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I should get it back to him...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?! What's happening...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Am I still in SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That ball must've been what caused this.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I have no memory of this place...
But it seems vaguely familiar for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This place as a whole feels foreign, but I swear I've seen these objects and designs before somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, just try to relax and slowly figure out what's going on...
One, two! One, two!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm...? I hear people...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, that's...
One, two!
One☆ Two☆
One... Two... Ugh... I'm exhausted...

Hey, no slacking!
We won't be able to go to the moon if we don't hurry up and move this thing!
That's easier said than done...
There's no way the three of us can carry a cannon big enough to launch a person all by ourselves...

But we're so close.
Just a little further♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's Tsukasa, Emu and Nene as far as I can tell...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But they're tiny...
Small enough to fit in the palm of my hand.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa?
rows.Line:
Hm? Who goes there?
If you have nothing else to do, lend us a hand, will you...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa?
rows.Line:
N-Noooo, it's a giant!
Everyone, play dead! Play dead!

rows.Speaker: Emu?
rows.Line: Wow, I've never seen a real giant before! Hi, Mr. Giant!

rows.Speaker: Nene?
rows.Line:
Why are you trying to talk to it?!
Also, playing dead won't help us at this point! Let's get out of here before we get eaten!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't worry. I won't eat you. Actually, would you mind if I asked you a few questions?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So you're carrying this big cannon over in the hopes that you can launch yourselves to the moon...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa?
rows.Line: Yes, precisely! It'd be quite the feat, would it not?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It certainly would be.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But they've given me a clue as to where I am now.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (These are all buildings and objects that appear in those science fiction novels I read.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (All that remains is to figure out how to return to SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Us meeting like this must mean something. How about I help you out with your great endeavor?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa?
rows.Line: What?! You will?!

rows.Speaker: Emu?
rows.Line: Yay! We're friends with Mr. Giant now♪

rows.Speaker: Nene?
rows.Line: Really...? But...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Things will go much smoother if I help and you should be able to safely reach the moon.

rows.Speaker: Nene?
rows.Line:
Safely...
Yeah, we need to put a priority on that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa?
rows.Line:
Then it's settled!
Let's work together and make it a successful launch!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui?
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ready, everyone...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa?
rows.Line:
We are indeed!
Thank you for all your help!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I should be thanking you for hearing me out and believing my instructions...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Even in this strange place, you're all still you...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa?
rows.Line: While we're on the subject...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa?
rows.Line: This experiment was able to succeed because of you, so...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa?
rows.Line: How about you help us with our next one?

rows.Speaker: Emu?
rows.Line:
Yeah, join us♪
I bet we can do something really really super amazing if we work together☆

rows.Speaker: Nene?
rows.Line: I agree... You were even able to make this cannon much safer to use than it originally was.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I'll have to turn down your offer. I'm sorry.

rows.Speaker: Emu?
rows.Line: What?! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because I too have friends who mean quite a lot to me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's uncanny how similar you all are to them... Alas, I must be returning soon.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa?
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa?
rows.Line: Hah...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa?
rows.Line: Hah hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa?
rows.Line: Your friends are just like us, which means you can't possibly ask for better!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, exactly!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa?
rows.Line:
Alright, nameless friend!
Our last hurrah can start with you lighting the fuse!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, leave it to me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa?
rows.Line: Excellent! Into the cannon, we go!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene?
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Here it goes...!
song00006_off_f

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ready? If anything does happen along the way, please be sure to refer to the instructions...

rows.Speaker: Nene's Voice?
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what do to. I'm actually pretty good at these kinds of controls.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice?
rows.Line: I'm ready too. I've got a greeting all memorized juuust in case we run into some moon people♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice?
rows.Line: Yes, and you can leave the rest to me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice?
rows.Line: I believe this cannon you built for us will launch me further and higher than ever before!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice?
rows.Line: There's nothing we can't do!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
I agree completely!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We could even perform a show on the moon as long as we're together...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm...? Where am I...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Welcome back, Rui.
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh? KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is everything okay? I think a fragment of a feeling sent you to a different SEKAI just now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A fragment of a feeling? A different SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, they're SEKAI that can appear temporarily out of a fragment of somebody's feeling.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You saw something rather interesting, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that explains quite a bit... That ball of light I picked up must be the fragment you're talking about, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Indeed. They don't appear very often, so in a way, you were very lucky to find it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you happen to know who that feeling belongs to...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, I can't say since I didn't actually feel what you felt...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I may be able to help if I knew a little more about what this SEKAI was like...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What that SEKAI was like...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice?
rows.Line: I believe this cannon you built for us will launch me further and higher than ever before!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice?
rows.Line: There's nothing we can't do!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem to already know...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I won't be forgetting what I experienced any time soon...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, that's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Anything one man can imagine, other men can make real.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I can believe in those words now that I have Tsukasa, Emu and Nene...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'm already starting to get some fantastic ideas...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe!
Riley Dream Park
“The Little Kingdom” show stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What a wonderful show!
I wouldn't mind seeing it again right now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, me too. Right, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think I counted twenty cast members, and the theatre had a capacity of...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's probably writing down what she felt because she liked it so much, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm sure she is, but she also seems very preoccupied.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In your case, Rui, you get this creepy grin on your face whenever you're trying to come up with new ideas.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's not very nice...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Right!
I promise to learn as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Keisuke, Shosuke, you'll be coming with me to headquarters. Emu, I'd like you and your friends to go around and enjoy the park for the rest of the day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was really hoping to ask you some questions, Mr. Riley...! And maybe even see what your meeting with Keisuke and Shosuke's like...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... It's almost like Emu's trying to be more organized and responsible today...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu usually relies on pathos to discuss or talk about things, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A prime example of this is how she described the show we just saw as being “extra exciting and super spectacular!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It just doesn't feel right when you say it, but I think I get your point...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: See what I mean? Her thought process is full of wonderfully creative and original ideas...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it's as if she's deliberately trying to suppress that today...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... Doesn't it just mean she's trying to learn as much as she can for the sake of Phoenix Wonderland?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That could very well be the case.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not telling you all sooner...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I didn't want this to get in the way of trying to win the Show Contest...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I would've felt awful if it made everyone sad and... I couldn't bear doing that to you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In my opinion, Emu's at her best whenever she's one with her emotions...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But at times she'll show hints of absolute brilliance in terms of actively trying to make someone smile or laugh.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Some may call that childish, but I believe it's one of her best qualities.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What do you think? Should we go talk to her?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, we may want to sit back and observe for the time being...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She seemed to genuinely enjoy the show, so she does appear to be having fun to some degree.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right. I wouldn't want to get in the way of her process or whatever it is she's doing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sour face...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Spicy face!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yummy face☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hehe. There's our usual Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, as bright as ever too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Maybe I'm overthinking this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I can't believe they made it so the water forms waves since it doesn't look like it's open to the public like a wave pool or something, you know?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, immersion must've been a top priority for them here. This beach alone lets you dive right into the story's narrative.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How do you think they did all this, you guys?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose it begins with how realistic the prospects of building an ocean such as this are.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How realistic?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, is it me or did Emu look really sad just now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I saw that too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui! Nene! Quit dragging your feet or we'll lose Emu and our little friend!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
We aren't dragging our feet.
We're just concerned...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: About Emu?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Come to think of it, she has been writing down notes all day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was sure that she'd run around the park today saying, “Everything's so fun and exciting and wonderhoy!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you noticed too...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, we'll need to get that girl to the Compass Center first before asking Emu if anything's going on...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right.
I'm sure family's worried sick about her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let's catch up to them before we end up losing both Emu and our little friend.
A few days after returning
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I have to say, I learned quite a lot during our trip to Riley Dream Park.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That show we saw clearly had the biggest impact on us, but...)
“Jungle Music” area

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But these trees are imitations...
And yet, it feels like we've wandered into a real jungle for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: We consulted with some botanists regarding how we could simulate the real thing. Those trees may be manmade, but they help create a very jungle-like atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Thanks to them, we were able to come very close to what we wanted. After that, we just had to build some waterfalls and research what jungles sound and even smell like.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I always wonder how I can stimulate all five senses when I'm working on a show.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (How things smell being one of them...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, the Wonder Stage is ultimately an outdoor stage. As such, I've been avoiding ideas and effects that can be affected by the weather.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But rain and wind are natural to any jungle. The way they designed that area made it so the weather doesn't affect what people experience all that much.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So some of the smells they use aren't affected by rain, wind or weather in general?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (If anything, rain would make that area feel even more like a real jungle.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Wait, that's it...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's not about avoiding bad weather. It's about having people experience the same place in different ways based on the weather...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. How foolish of me. I've been closing doors to new opportunities this whole time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all, it's the director's job to make the impossible a reality...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...
A few days later
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We're here, Rui.
What is it that you need us to try out?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? Where's Rui?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's not running late, is he?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, his garage was empty by the time I left my house, so he should be here already.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that means he's... Hey, look!
There's a name card on that seat over there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, it's my name!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? This one says my name...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And mine's way over there.
So we're supposed to sit where we've been assigned...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Probably...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, I'm in my seat!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu's front and center, but we're in the back and off to each side.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha! Look, we make a perfect triangle!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, if you draw lines between us...
What in the world is Rui up to now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, I'm guessing that we're supposed to be the audience and Rui's gonna appear on stage to...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, did you see something?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, I smell something sweet!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Sniff sniff*
I knew it! Flowers! And it's coming from the stage!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, you're right...
I can smell it from here now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You can?
I can't smell anything...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... It might be because you're upwind.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What if you breathed in really deep like this?
*Sniiifff*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What, like some sort of vacuum cleaner? Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sniff sniff*
I'm not smelling flowers. This seems like something else.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, it smells like a forest...
It's as if trees are breathing all around me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's probably just the scent of a forest. Also, I really doubt trees breathe the way you're imagining them to right now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I can smell it now too!
It's really a forest!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It's coming my way too.
Yeah, it really does smell like a forest...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But why's it a forest now? What happened to the flowers?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know the answer to that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui! You've already begun your experiment, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Nicely done, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, it's Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
I apologize for not explaining things sooner, but my goal was to get some natural impressions of this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You mean from these smells?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, as it happens...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. An effect that stimulates a person's sense of smell...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I'd been avoiding it all this time because of certain things that are out of our control, but I've decided to start experimenting with ideas like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In this case, I'm sure you all noticed that you'll smell different things at varying times depending on where you sit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So what's your verdict?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Can we use this for our next show?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, it's not quite ready for the stage yet.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As it stands, there's still too much variation in terms of how and when these smells reach everybody in the audience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like to keep experimenting with this to see how much I can fine-tune it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, are there any other ideas like this that you think we should test out?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Test out?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We'll certainly need to keep honing our craft to put on better shows, but I believe new and innovative ideas will also become necessary.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I won't be able to test these ideas on my own, so I'd really appreciate your help whenever possible... As I've been doing with Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Conversely, I'd like it if you could come to me for help as well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Does that mean you'd be willing to make stuff for us if we ask?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
As long as it's within my power to do so.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
Sounds like a plan!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I actually came up with a whole bunch of ideas after we got back from our trip♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I thought really hard about what I can do to make them happen, but I'd love to hear what you think too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Gladly. It's sort of my forte, so please feel free to ask me whenever.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Can we take a look at some now?! Like... This one!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's have a look.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nice work today, you guys♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, good work.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Our practices are going rather smoothly. That just leaves whether or not Tsukasa will be able to join us...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (No, he will...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (KAITO mentioned how he seems to be on the right track, so now's not the time to fret.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, let's clean up and...

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line:
<Hey! Emu, Nene, Rui♪
Anyone home?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Miku!
Lemme grab my phone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Already...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Incredible! Now that's efficiency!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Wahoy♪ Thanks, Emu☆
Oh, Nene, Rui, you're both here too!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we are. What brings you here all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, about that!
There's something I wanna ask you, Rui♪>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ask me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Which is why I wanna try “looking for something in common” like Tsukasa's doing...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <For that other show you did as ambassadors, you noticed that Nene and the Little Mermaid both like to play video games, right? Is it similar to that?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna know too!
Rui, please tell us!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
I'll explain in order.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
First, Miku's example.
About how “Nene and the Little Mermaid both like to play video games”...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your interpretation is correct in terms of “finding something in common”.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<In terms of just that...
So it's not perfectly correct...?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. The perfectly correct answer begins with asking, “Why do Nene and the Little Mermaid both like to play video games?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, Nene, mind telling Miku and Emu about how you went about taking on the role of the Little Mermaid?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?!
You're dumping this on me...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... I started with how this Little Mermaid was pretty shy but wanted to see something new because she was tired of seeing the same stuff every day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, and...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But the outside world... The world of humans is dangerous, so I figured that she'd prefer to discover new places by immersing herself in video games.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Books can provide similar enjoyment, but I thought video games would be better since you can control where you explore and what you do on adventures...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, you can play them for hours on end. And the more games you have, the more worlds you can effectively explore.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<That makes so much sense♪
But was any of that in the actual script?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, no, it wasn't.
But this “love of video games” gave Nene the connection she needed to become the Little Mermaid.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa... That's so cool, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? Emu, you went through quite a lot to play the role of Shao, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shao had lost her parents to the war, but Miles took her in to become both her mentor and only family.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That show was also inspired by what your grandfather had to go through when founding Phoenix Wonderland...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You felt a strong connection in terms of protecting something that was entrusted to you by another family member, no?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I had no idea...!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It isn't just about acting the same. It's really about being the same and filling their shoes!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's perfectly correct.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But Thorpe's a tricky one.
I mean, you and he are essentially polar opposites in terms of personalities.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's the layer of added difficulty Tsukasa is currently facing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hmm... Yeah, it's easy to say how we differ, but this is about finding common ground...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Do you think you can handle it...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<To be honest, I'm not sure...
But I wanna give it a try!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Especially since Tsukasa's trying his best already♪>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I couldn't agree more...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Thanks for teaching me all this, Rui!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Thank you both too, Emu, Nene!
I promise to do my best!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And she's gone like the usual storm she is.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. She and Tsukasa seem to have that in common.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... So who do you think is gonna figure out Thorpe first? Tsukasa or Miku?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I really can't say.
This may just come down to some sort of serendipity.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Serendipity?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. A chance discovery that leads one to a profound realization.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Will our dear troupe leader be able to make such a discovery...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We'll be awaiting good news, Tsukasa...)
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Our show at the music hall couldn't have gone better.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (For a while there, we weren't sure if we could actually go through with it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But Tsukasa gave us an incredible performance.)

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
I only have half a day left...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “The stars... They're so beautiful...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He even managed to figure out how to handle the scene where Thorpe looks at the stars.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway... We'll be having a discussion surrounding our next regular show tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... It may be a good opportunity for me to bring that thing up as well.
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's pick up where we left off yesterday regarding our next regular show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We have a few ideas on the table, so wanna start chipping away at those?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... But there's still a chance that we could come up with a really fun idea for a show♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I agree. There's no need for us to rush anything out right now, so let's take this opportunity to get on the same page.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, would you mind hearing my suggestion?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You have a suggestion?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. This has been on my mind ever since we decided that Tsukasa would play Thorpe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh? What could this entail?
Let's hear it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Remember the show we did with the Black Knight? I was thinking we could do that again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The Black Knight?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You brought that up when you suggested that I find something that my character and I have in common...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But why now?
Mind telling us your reasons behind your idea?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Excellent questions.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Last time, you were able to successfully take on this role after discovering that you and the Black Knight were both very strong-willed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I have a feeling that you now have the power to further examine how this character thinks and feels.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In other words, you believe we'll be able to put on a better show than before!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! That'd be amazing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm kinda curious as to how Tsukasa would play the Black Knight now too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
See what I mean?
Feel up to it, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. Of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've taken a big step forward as an actor, so let's give everyone the new and improved Black Knight!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Wonderful!
Why don't we start by taking another look at the script?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The Black Knight is actually someone who loves peace and used his sword to protect people.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He was even revered as the “Knight of Peace”, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He began to change after having to fight in so many battles.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Exactly. He went from protecting others to defeating his enemies and becoming enamored with the sensation of achieving victory.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah... He only used to fight and try to win against his opponents because he wanted to protect everyone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Initially, it was just a means to an end, but it sort of wound up becoming his primary goal.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A means to an end becoming his goal...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I honestly never really thought about that last time, but I think I understand now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “To protect others” is to essentially run a marathon with no goal at the end.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You have no idea how far you have to go or if it'll ever end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But defeating one's enemies and fighting to win is much more cut and dry in terms of tangible outcomes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. And so, the Black Knight ended up choosing more easily achievable goals instead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'd labeled him as a “bad guy” before without actually thinking about him as a human being...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But now I understand...
The Black Knight and I are one and the same.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? The same?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I too foolishly placed my goal of becoming a star over making the audience and my friends smile.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Fortunately, you and the Black Knight were both able to make that realization.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Precisely...!
And I have all of you to thank.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This means I'll have to revisit my old, naive self...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But even going over just the beginning has uncovered all these ways I can improve my understanding of this character.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If we keep this up, I'm sure we'll be able to put on a show that's orders of magnitude better than before!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be counting on you, Tsukasa!
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay, it's done...
We can start practicing this new part tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Working out how to accommodate everyone's individual athletic abilities and experiences in this plan took longer than I expected.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, this is the most effective way of making our performance the best it can possibly be.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And I won't have to feel the regret of not trying it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Still...
I'm surprised that they were willing to agree to this.)

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Kamishiro, you're certain that your idea will make our performance for the cheering competition just that much better?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Understood.
Then, there's no reason not to.
Am I right...?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: This is gonna take some courage to pull off, but I agree that this is probably gonna make the crowd go absolutely wild.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line:
Let's do it, you guys!
Everything we have until the day of!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... I really should get in some rest ahead of tomorrow's practice... Hehe. But I feel wide awake now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Oh, I know...)
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? It's night here too?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I was hoping to thank Luka for helping me and giving me advice...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rui, it's you. I was wondering who came to visit so late. What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. You wish to thank Luka...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
But I'm guessing she's asleep right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin and Len may be, but I'm not sure about Luka... She slept throughout most of the day, so she may actually be awake.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, Rui, you have school tomorrow, no? I'll help you look for her to speed things up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you, KAITO. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Alright, shall we?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That reminds me.
MEIKO said that you were hoping to discuss something with me the other time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm sorry that I wasn't there to help.
One of the plushies that was supposed to be in our show got lost and I had to go look for them with the others.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Luckily, we managed to find them, which was a huge relief.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But I'm actually okay now.
Luka and the others were there to listen to what I was hoping to discuss.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I heard.
By the way, what did you talk about with them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well... I came up with an idea that's bound to make our performance for the cheering competition significantly better.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I wasn't sure if I should bring it up since we don't have much time left until the Sports Festival on top of it being rather challenging...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But Luka made me realize something.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was subconsciously scared of being shunned by everyone on the cheer squad.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought Tsukasa and the others had helped me get over that already.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But a part of me was clearly still afraid.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But based on what you just said, I take it that you were able to bring your idea up with the cheer squad...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So... I'm hoping that everything is fine now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I hope so too...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, Rui, being timid or scared isn't necessarily a bad thing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. You've said so yourself.
It's best to take it slow when making important decisions, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course, it's natural to believe that moving forward is the quickest way towards growth.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I think you should just move at your own pace, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At my own pace?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You need to muster up some courage when facing a big obstacle. Not only that, you may require the help of your friends.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's why I believe you should move at your own pace and act when you think you have all the pieces you need.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Conversely, when you think the time isn't right, I'd like it if you kept in mind that you don't have to immediately act.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That also takes some amount of courage, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (When I think I have all the pieces I need...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I see. In that sense, this was definitely the right time for me to act.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What you told me just now makes me want to thank Luka just that much more...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We want to... Cheer too... Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It'll be... Great... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You can... Do it... Rui...
Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sounds like they're all cheering for you in their dreams, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it does.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Thank you all very much...
I promise to follow through with this until the end.)
Kamiyama High School - Campus

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: For the blue teeeaaam!!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
What?!
Wait... The rooftop?!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
It's the Captain of the blue team!
The other squad members are by the classroom windows too... What are they all doing there...?

rows.Speaker: Blue Team Students
rows.Line: Way to go, blue cheer squad!

rows.Speaker: Blue Team Students
rows.Line: You guys gave us so much energy!

rows.Speaker: Blue Team Students
rows.Line:
We might be in last right now...
But it's not over until it's over!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Captain, I think your passion's touched everyone's hearts.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rui!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How was it?! Absolutely perfect, right?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it was a wonderful performance.
There's no room for me to complain.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Awesome! That just leaves the voting for the cheering competition! I hope they finish counting soon!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too. But we should also take this opportunity to head back to our class waiting areas... We still have the next event to think about.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right! We need to start gathering soon! Let's go, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay. See you, Rui!
Let's meet up later to talk more about the cheering competition!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, see you later.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<There we are.
Nice work, Rui.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, we just managed to get in a peek! The cheering competition was so amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Luka, MEIKO...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Oh, I haven't had a chance to thank Luka and the others yet.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Perfect timing.
About the cheering competition...

rows.Speaker: Student's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, those two are back! Nice work!

rows.Speaker: Student's Voice
rows.Line: The blue team's performance was so good!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hm? They seem awfully excited.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I think it's coming from the waiting area for my class.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Whoa...! Thanks, you guys!
I'm glad you all liked our performance so much.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah, being the representatives for Class B was definitely worth it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, Rui, aren't they on your cheer squad? Hehe. Everyone around them's smiling so much.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they really are.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmates
rows.Line:
Seriously, that opening scene was nuts!
No one expected you guys to jump out of the windows!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line:
Kamishiro came up with that part.
We didn't have much time to practice it, so I wasn't sure we'd be able to pull it off.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah, I wasn't really for it either at first...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmates
rows.Line: Really...? It definitely looked really cool, but he's actually the one who came up with that idea...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I should tell the Captain that I need to head back to my class for now. I'll be right back...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Wait, Rui...!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Is he going to be okay...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmates
rows.Line:
And everything went okay?
You didn't get hurt or anything, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate A
rows.Line:
No, we were totally fine.
Kamishiro made sure to put safety first.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah! You guys gotta hear this!
It was incredible!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Rui, please wait...!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh, here! This says how we practiced that window jump, but they're all a little different depending on which clubs we're in or what we're good at doing.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: He even went around to each of us to explain how our safety equipment all works.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah. And just in case we didn't land properly, he had a safety mat ready to catch us.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: That made such a huge difference when it came to actually getting ourselves to jump.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmates
rows.Line: Really...? I never would've expected Kamishiro to be so thoughtful of others.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmates
rows.Line:
I know, right?
I mean, it's impossible to tell what he's thinking most of the time...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: I felt the same way, but he seemed really different during practice...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: It was like you could tell he shared our wish. As if he was thinking, “I want to encourage everyone by making this performance a success.”

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmates
rows.Line: I see... So Kamishiro went through all that trouble to give us encouragement...?

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Rui, why don't you head back to your class?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yeah, look!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But... I...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I know...!
MEIKO, would you mind...?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I see... Yes... Okay♪>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What were you two just...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Look! Kamishiro's back!
We should be there to welcome him!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?! MEIKO?!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmates
rows.Line: Huh? Kamishiro? Where?

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line:
Oh, there he is!
Hey, you're late!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now you've done it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Haha! Anyway, we'll be off♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. See you later...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay... See you later...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmate B
rows.Line: Kamishiro, welcome back!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Classmates
rows.Line: Welcome back!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
It's good to be back...
Coast

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wait, aren't you gonna go check out that jungle?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, but there's something I'd like to check on first.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. It's nice and sunny out, so I'm perfectly fine with just walking along the coast.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Okay, you...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ah, there also seem to be birds here.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's difficult to tell which species just based their calls, but at the very least, this ecosystem seems to support animal life.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (These plants look more or less familiar as well, and none seem to be the kind that cause rashes or skin irritation. Good.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That means we should be safe as long as we keep an eye out for any big animals.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you all for waiting. After taking a quick look around, there doesn't seem to be any dangerous plants here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, let's head into the jungle to search for food and water.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, so you went around to see what kinds of plants there were?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I didn't realize you knew so much about plants, Rui! That's on top of everything you know about gizmos and gadgets☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I really only know about the plants I saw in encyclopedias when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I remember reading this one encyclopedia over and over again because it was all about poisonous plants.

rows.Speaker: Len & MEIKO
rows.Line: <An encyclopedia about poisonous plants?!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, wait... Are you talking about the weird book with that creepy, red, poisonous-looking cover?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that's precisely it!
Even now, I'm able to discern in an instant whether or not a plant is dangerous.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Wow, that's so interesting!
Mind if I borrow that book from you sometime, Rui♪>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
I'll bring it over to SEKAI next time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, we'll need to get our phones fixed first...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Our phones won't even turn on now because of how they went for a swim in the ocean.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. KAITO, there's something I'd like to ask you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hm? How can I help you?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Untitled is also on our phone. If they end up being broken beyond repair, what's going to happen to it?

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Oh no...!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Th-That's a really good question! If we can't get them fixed, does it mean we can never go back to SEKAI anymore?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... I really don't want that to happen...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He has a point... KAITO, can you give us an answer?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I believe everything will be fine.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Even if you do end up replacing your old phones with new ones, Untitled should naturally reappear.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, how does that work exactly...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm sorry. I can't say for sure, but I do know that Untitled is a song that for one reason or another reacts to people's feelings...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <So, as long as you carry these feelings, Untitled will never disappear from your phones.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yup yup☆ SEKAI isn't going anywhere either♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, I was able to cloud save Untitled and the rest of the data on my phone. Will that Untitled work the same if I were to download it?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I can't say for certain, but I suspect so.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means the feelings of the person playing the song are what matters most, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We learned something very interesting today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, one more thing...
If I were to use Tsukasa's phone to go over to SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What would happen in the event that his phone broke?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Wouldn't you just be sent back here since Untitled would be forced to stop?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hmm... I'm guessing that's what will happen.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, as I suspected...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Lucky for us, Tsukasa's phone is still working, but we don't know for how long...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We'd be able to guarantee our own safety by taking shelter in SEKAI, but that may very well end up being a temporary solution...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (If that's the case, it may be better for us to gather and set up everything we need to survive.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui? You there...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You seem to have a lot on your mind. If you're concerned about something, then please tell us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's no telling how long we're going to be stuck in this situation, but we have to find a way to survive together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I understand.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And there is something I need to tell all of you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: First, Tsukasa, it's nothing short of a miracle that your phone's still working.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Smartphones have become waterproof to some extent, but if water's gotten into the circuits and your luck runs out, there's a chance that it can short out and explode.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line: <It's gonna explooode?!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, that's terrifying...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Settle down. He said that it's a possibility, not a certainty.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Normally, it's best to turn it off immediately, but if you were to do that, the chances of it turning back on are next to nothing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I prefer not to think about things going south. However, this may end up becoming our ace in the hole since it'll allow us to take shelter in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, Tsukasa, as much as I hate to ask this of you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Keep my phone on, right?!
Leave it to me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But if it starts smoking up or making odd noises, please discard it immediately, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
S-So, Rui...
Does what you just said also apply to Robo-Nene?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it does.
However, we may need Robo-Nene's various gadgets and features later if find ourselves in a bind.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like to avoid asking her doing anything strenuous since it'll likely make her core temperature rise too high.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A-And that'll keep Robo-Nene from exploding?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We'll have to keep an eye on her moving forward, but she seems to have avoided being seriously damaged so she should be okay as long as we're careful.

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, I've been talking for quite a while now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, once more, let's head into the jungle to search for food and water.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course!
Desert Island - Jungle

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You guys have so much food now after the monkeys gave you these fruits.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆ I can't wait to try them out since they all look really yummy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<*Yawn*
Seeing all these delicious-looking fruits... Is making me...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'm also starting to get hungry.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <No, the opposite actually...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, the opposite?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Mhm... That sensation of being full... I'm starting to get sleepy, so... Good... Night...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh, you... Come here if you want to take a nap.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Luka, ever our sleeping beauty.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Rui?
Something's been on your mind for a while now it seems? What's bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
There is one small matter that's caught my concern.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Are you talking about finding drinkable water...?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We've managed to find food, but not being able to find a source of water is quite the conundrum...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Water, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The contraption we set up by the beach has only been able to collect a small amount so far.

rows.Speaker: Rui
