rows.Line: So, finding a source somewhere within this jungle was sort of our best option...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah. Even after walking around all day, there was no sign of one... Are there really no good sources of water in this jungle...?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I have to believe otherwise.
I mean, just look at all the monkeys living in this jungle.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, you're right! The monkeys need water too!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, so there has to be a decent source somewhere in here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Rui?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?! What did you figure out?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Look. I think that path over there was made by some animals...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, good eye...
There's evidence of small animals having passed through here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Do you think it was the monkeys?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have to think so.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you all mind if we made a slight detour...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This path may very well lead to a source of water or evidence of one existing, so I'd like to investigate.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Are you sure...?
The sun's going to set completely soon...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, because this is likely going to be our last chance today to find a source of water in this jungle.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't think we have a choice. At this point, not having water would be beyond detrimental!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, we don't have much time, so we'll need to hurry.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hmm... Water... Water...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Water... Water...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Nor any drop to drink...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Not a drop. I can try listening more closely for the sound of water... Still nothing...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It may be hiding behind some bushes or grass, so let's keep a close eye out, everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right! We have so many eyes on the case now. We're bound to find something!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We're absolutely gonna find it☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Speaking of which... I'm glad for you, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Because if the monkeys didn't give us all those fruits, you wouldn't have had anything to eat other than the bananas.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, that's right... Rui isn't exactly a big fan of vegetables...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, yeah! All the herbs we picked would count as veggies!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh... Based on your current situation, do you really think you can afford to be picky?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, but if I refuse to eat any vegetables, there will be more for everyone else. In a way, two birds with one stone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nonsense. Also, why are you smiling...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, you're both a valued cast member and director of Wonderlands×Showtime. We can't have anything happening to you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, if push comes to shove and it means saving your life, I'll have no other choice but to make you eat your vegetables.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I appreciate the thought, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My body may live on, but if you were to do that, my heart may burst and cause me to sleep the big sleep.

rows.Speaker: Emu & Miku
rows.Line:
What?!
<What?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Geez, you hate vegetables that much...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Only as much as I just said.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Well, in that case...
I'm glad you were given those fruits.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm...? Hmmm!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What is it, Emu?
Did you find something?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I just saw some birds land in the bushes over there!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The bushes...? Not the branches...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
<We found it...!>
We found it...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well done, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Well done indeed.
You found these birds' watering hole.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Rui, does this water look okay to you? It sort of just looks like a really big puddle.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, there seems to be plenty of water and a spring acting as its source.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But just to be safe, we should boil it before we do try to drink it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right.
And now, we can head back to where Robo-Nene is with our heads held high!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, thank goodness too...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's collect some water and head straight back!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Yeah!
Two weeks until Rui's birthday
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Emu, Nene.
Mind helping me put the props away?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Let's go, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure!
Rui, the background curtain's all rolled up over there...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay. I just have to take it around back, yes? We should be set here, so please go lend Tsukasa a hand.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, we'll do that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Rui, Rui☆
We picked up all the flowers we made go pop-pop and fly around♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku, Len.
Now, can you help me by putting them in this bag?

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line:
Okay!
O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Len...?
You seem anxious. Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, um... It's nothing!
It's just... There's something I'd like to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ask me? How can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So... It's almost your birthday, right?
I was wondering if there's anything you want to do to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My birthday? Yes, it's a week after next, but I'd completely forgotten since our next show's also just around the corner.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line: *Stare*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There actually is something I'd really like to do for my birthday...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
There is...?!
Like what?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. A birthday party.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just once, I'd like to invite all of my friends over to my house for a big birthday party.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow! That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah☆ I wanna celebrate too, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. I'd love to have you all over.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, we couldn't help but overhear that you may or may not want to throw a birthday party.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Something about inviting all your friends over to your house too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Something about...? You heard everything while pretending to put the props away, no?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! Operation Eavesdrop 'n' Prop Clean Up failed!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How could this have happened...?!
Even after we asked Miku and Len to help us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Of course he figured out what was going on. I mean, the way you were staring at him was a dead giveaway.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I see... That explains why Len seemed so anxious. He was asked to draw out some answers from me.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You know you could've just asked me directly without having to go through all this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To be honest, we weren't expecting you to say anything about inviting your friends over for a party at your house. It seemed too ordinary.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. It's about as ordinary as it gets.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui, you're okay with just that?
Now that our plan's been foiled, please feel free to ask us for anything. You don't have to hold back.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup! We mean it! Anything!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I really appreciate it, you two, but why would I now choose to start holding anything back from all of you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
This is genuinely what I wish to do.
A perfectly ordinary birthday party like you'd see anywhere else.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If Rui's saying that's what he wants to do, then I say why not? I live right next door too, so why don't I bring over some games we can all play?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, good idea!
Much appreciated.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I guess we're going with a perfectly ordinary party...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That means we'll need candles for the cake, party goods and snacks!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I'll bring over some decorations and yummy snacks!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, and we'll make sure to get everything ready so that we can celebrate with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's start by asking KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, good call!
Let's go ask him♪
Two weeks later
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm? A message...?
From Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Rui, you're still up, right?
Happy birthday!!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, it's already past midnight...
When did that happen?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Got any fun plans for today?
If you're gonna do something at school, I'll make sure to stop by!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I won't be doing anything at school.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Instead, I'll be having a simple party with my fellow troupe members and everyone who's helped us along the way.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Really?!
A simple party, huh? That sounds nice!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Good for you, Rui.
Have lots of fun, okay♪>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
<Yes, I plan to.
Thank you, Mizuki.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Everyone have their poppers ready?
Also, how are the candles on the cake looking?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, they're all set.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We're ready over here too!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Looks like we're all eager to get started.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Of course we are! We've been waiting two weeks for this♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let us commence our celebration! First, we will begin by wishing Rui a happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, lemme hit the lights♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, without further ado!
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now, without further ado!
Happy birthday, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
<Happy birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: *Blow*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Rui!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, give me the plates!
It's time to cut the cake!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <KAITO! We want cake too♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Okay, I understand. But we have to wait for our turn.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Okay, now that we've had our fill of delicious cake, juice and snacks...!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It's time to celebrate by starting with the Happy Birthday Rui Cookie Kart Cup♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yay♪>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey, Rui, what's a Cookie Kart?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a racing game with a strangely fun story that involves these gingerbread men that are made from unbaked cookie dough and race in these go-karts that are also made of dough.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They race on these tracks and circuits that all look very different but each is actually an oven.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you pass through a track's checkpoints a certain number of times, the gingerbread men will be baked to perfection.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But they can't keep racing if they're not baked properly and get disqualified if they become burnt. It's an interesting game with some unique rules.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Yeah, that does sound interesting.
Is it normal to play something like this during birthday parties?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't say for sure, but it's been around for a long time. We played it with Toya, Ichika and the others whenever they came over to our house for birthday parties.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've played it before too! During birthday parties, and even outside of birthdays with my sis and the plushies!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I never played it much during birthday parties, but I remember playing it with Nene on a regular basis.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, we did. And our parents made it a rule that we couldn't play online.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, you guys have all played this before? That means it's gonna turn into a pretty heated battle, right?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Alright, without further ado, let's kick off the first race of Rui's Birthday Cup!!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! I got disqualified! My gingerbread man got burnt to a crisp!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that way does lead to a shortcut, but it doesn't seem possible to get through there without getting roasted...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Finally! I got the can cover!
Now I can take the shortcut!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You're going down the fiery road, Nene?! But you'll get all burned up like Emu just before the finish line!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, she won't! The can cover she just used will keep her safe as she runs through the flames.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. Exactly.
So, smell you later.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Looks like Nene's going to win and have a nice, golden brown finish.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wah hah hah hah!
Not so fast!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh, looks like Emu's returned as a charcoal cookie after being disqualified from the race!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hang on... What in the world's a charcoal cookie?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a form that allows players to interfere in a race after being disqualified for getting too burnt.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's right! And if I hit someone with my charcoal bomb just right, I can raise their burn gauge☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'd completely forgotten about that...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And everyone's already a nice, golden brown since we're nearing the end of the race, so one blast will spell the end for anyone who gets hit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Come and play, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wh-What?! W-Wait!
Why me?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, Emu go get her!
It'll be just me and Rui if Nene gets disqualified!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That certainly would be exciting, but you may want to watch where you're going, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Noooo! What's this hidden bomb doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh no! Tsukasa's got burnt to a crisp! Does this mean he's disqualified?!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <No, it looks like he's just barely within the threshold for staying in the race!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
You'll have to do better than that, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nonetheless, well played!
Once I catch up to you, I'm going to use my secret weapon to turn you into a star!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, that sounds bad...
You must be talking about the item that can transform others into something else and slow them down in the process.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wait, there's an item that lets you do that?! Go, Rui, go!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<And here are the results...♪
The winner of Rui's Birthday Cup is...!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Emuuu!!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! I won!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Congratulations, Emu!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Even though she was disqualified from the first race, she really turned everything around by winning the second and third ones.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr! She stole the second race right under our noses while we traded blows with one another.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only that, I was staggered by how good the items we started getting during the later half of the race were.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I couldn't believe it when I got three rare items in a row.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So, wanna play again...?
I kinda don't wanna just walk away after losing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and I finished last, so there's nowhere for me to go but up! You're playing too, right, Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, which track do you guys wanna play next? Or do you wanna set it to random again?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Well, let's see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's been so long since I last celebrated with such a lively birthday party...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And Nene was just about my only friend who would ever come.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So this is what it's like to throw a perfectly ordinary birthday party with my friends.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you all very much...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'm so happy for you, Rui.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Akito
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really enjoyed what you and the others did for my birthday the other day, so I hope you get to have as much fun as possible today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I heard that you'll be having a party with Tsukasa and the others at your home. I'm sure you're all going to have quite a bit of fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, there's really nothing better than celebrating your birthday with your closest friends and acquaintances.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys come up with pretty zany ideas sometimes, but you and your troupe put on shows to make people smile so I'm sure you're also good at entertaining yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Rui!
You showed some signs of it during the Sports Festival, but you've really changed for the better. Is it because of Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's always nice to see you having fun, so I hope you get to keep doing lots of stuff with him and the others.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Once again, Rui, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line:
Happy birthdaaay!
Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Cookie Kart was so much fun! I can't believe we did five more tournaments after that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and Rui got pretty into it, so I think he really enjoyed himself.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I was worried at first about throwing an “ordinary” birthday party for him, but it was nice to see that he had so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, I know you don't hold back when it comes to shows, but you're free to ask us for anything outside of that like what we just did.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup☆
We should keep doing lots and lots of stuff together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'd like that as well.
So, make sure to let us know if anything comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello there. Thank you for joining me today to celebrate my birthday.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I never realized how fun it was to celebrate alongside my friends and acquaintances like this. I'd forgotten since so much time had passed when I last did.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. If possible, I'd like to do something like this again next time.
Shibuya Festa - Backstage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, it looks like the festival's about to wrap up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why don't we start packing up and get ready to go back to Phoenix Wonderland?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Actually, most of our stuff's already been packed up. It's sitting right over there.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Then, this shouldn't take very long. Let's get the dolly and start carting them off to...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, Rui, hold on!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We can take care of the packing.
You should sit and rest!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's right. You're hurt, so you should rest as much as you can.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I appreciate your concern, but I'm fine. I should be able to do this much without any problems.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, Rui, you shouldn't take sprains lightly! If you push yourself too hard...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's with all the shouting...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Nice show, Tsukasa.
We came by to congratulate you all before we left.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Akito, Toya! Thank you for dropping by!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, we're here too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Um! I thought your show was really fun! Especially the part where you flew in the air, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your team's performance was also incredible! The way you all sang with so much power gave us a nice boost of energy! We thank you for that!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Really?
I was under the impression that you were always filled to the brim with energy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That's one of Tsukasa's best qualities. Also, please allow me to thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you hadn't helped me along back there, we probably wouldn't have been able to do our show today. I really appreciate what you did for me, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, um... You're welcome.
You guys put on a good show, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Back there...?
Now that you mention it, Akito, I've been meaning to ask you about that. Did something happen to Kamishiro?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's been bugging me too!
I definitely remember seeing you talking to Kamishiro before the show.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? No, that was just...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, you didn't tell them? Akito here helped Rui get to the first aid tent!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? The first aid tent...?
Does that mean you got hurt, Kamishiro?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Unfortunately, yes...
I was testing a device and ended up spraining my foot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You were all probably busy getting ready for your own show too. I apologize for borrowing Shinonome at such a crucial time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's okay...! We had a meeting during lunch, so we were actually ready to perform whenever.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, we really had no idea. Oh, Akito, you're such a good boy. Why didn't you tell us about your wonderful deed...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Quiet, you. I wasn't trying to hide it or anything. Also, Kamishiro, are you sure you're okay now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I am.
I received some nice treatment and was able to perform in our show just fine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But you moved around quite a bit after having your foot looked at, so maybe you should return to the first aid tent for a follow-up just in case.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
It'd be a shame if it got worse after you got home.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm not sure it'll get worse.
It doesn't hurt nearly as bad as before, so I should be okay.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But you might've had so much fun during our show that you just don't realize how much pain you're actually in...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, she's right! Your body might be full of so much adrenaline right now that it's masking the pain!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, you probably should take it easy...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Akito, where are you going?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, that's it!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What are you two doing...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I appreciate how you're all concerned for my well-being, but I really doubt that it's going to get that much worse...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Here you are, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Here, have a seat!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: On a dolly...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, it's for moving big props around!
By sitting on this, we'll be able to transport you around while minimizing the amount of work you have to do!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see. That's a good idea.
He should be able to fit as long as he tucks his knees in.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, if we use the dolly for me, we won't be able to move our other things...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh♪
I have that covered...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I told Shosuke about what happened and he said that he'll have someone come move our things!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nice work, Emu! Well done!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But...
I still don't feel great about being waited on like this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
A-Akito, where were you just now?
What is that? Ice...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I asked the man running the drinks stall over there for some.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Please, use this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, nothing's wrong. Thank you all very much. Then, if you don't mind transporting me, I'll use this to ice my foot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Get well soon, Kamishiro!
Stage Area

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: E-Everyone's staring at us...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We stand out quite a bit.
I'm not sure if there's anything we can do about that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's not a problem! And there's no need for the patient to mind them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'll try to sit back and relax. Although, my bottom does hurt a bit...
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! Welcome, everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We've been waiting for you, and we're all set to practice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you for filling in for me this past week, KAITO. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, it was my pleasure.
I'm just glad to see that you're all better now, Rui.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, he's right.
The bandage you had on your arm's gone!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it is.
The cuts and scratches I had are all healed now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What about your sprain? Had that healed?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It doesn't hurt anymore, so I should be able to start practicing with everyone again.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, wait, Rui!
I got a chance to ask Asahina about your injury!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You asked Asahina...? I see. Thank you. What did she say?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um... She said that the pain might be gone but you shouldn't do anything too strenuous!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, understood.
In that case, I'll rest again today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: For the sake of your show, Rui, we need to help you get better as quickly as possible. Until then, we'll need that thing again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup☆ We'll need that chair again!
I'll go get it for you, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, we need a chair, stat!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Roger☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Here you are, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you again.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'll be on chair duty tomorrow!
You can count on me, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why does it seem like everybody wants to be on chair duty...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You became inundated with chairs during the first day, Rui. There were so many.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But it looks like fun...☆
I think I'll try being on chair duty the day after tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wanna do it too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, me three.
Which chair would be... Zzz.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Get ready to see more chairs that day...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That means we'll be on call for clean-up duty, KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Aww, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I really wasn't expecting to get such a royal treatment after getting injured. Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
I mean, we just want you to get well soon, Rui.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly. Also, don't forget to keep resting when you're elsewhere.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I know. I've been able to take P.E. off, so I've definitely been able to take it easy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That goes for things outside of school as well! There are cases when testing your inventions can lead to... Well, unforeseen circumstances...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! So even if you build a new drone, no chasing after it or whatever, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I understand.
I'll rest as much as I can to let my injury heal.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Especially since I'd like to return to doing shows with all of you as soon as possible.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Rui...!
Yeah! We'll do lots and lots once you're back☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we'll need you back as soon as possible!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be fair, despite everything that happened, I thought we were rather fortunate...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because under different circumstances, we may have had to call off our show. Luckily, my role didn't require me to appear on stage all that much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all, I'd rather avoid having to deviate from the script because of an injury...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gah, Rui, you're missing the point!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We're not concerned about the show!
We're concerned about you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, he's right!
What if you can't be in the show because you got hurt again?! That'd be the worst!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We're worried about you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Rui...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You understand, don't you...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I mean...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, you're all right. Tsukasa, Emu, everyone... I apologize for making you all have to worry so much about me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I promise to be careful moving forward. I'll do my best not to get hurt.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay...
We'll be holding you to that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! You have to keep your promise!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start practicing for our next show!
Museum of Emerging Technologies - Main Gate Plaza

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Rui!
Can we take this stuff away?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is there anything else that needs carrying?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, everything's okay over here.
Thank you, Tsukasa, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anytime! Alright, Emu, let's go.
I'll push the dolly, so you keep an eye on it to make sure everything stays put.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Roger dodger!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, that just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If you're free, can you lend me a hand...? We still haven't cleaned up all the flower confetti yet...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, sure.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Is something the matter, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-Why do you ask...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because you've been staring at me for quite a while now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is there something you'd like to discuss? I suspect that you asked me to help clean because there is, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (To be fair, I already know why she's worried...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Those two immediately noticed that I was behaving differently... And I couldn't say anything...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, if this is about what happened the other day...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I know you're okay now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know what you and Asahi talked about, but I can tell that you feel much better now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't feel bad about not telling us about what happened. It's okay.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, did you wait all this time to tell me that?

rows.Speaker: Nene

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Miku☆
You were super close!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Heehee♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You may figure it out once you see the rest of the ingredients.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Flour, sugar, eggs, milk and butter.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! Isn't that everything you need to bake some sweets...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
But what's that weird rod for?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, it's all set.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wow, you put your little device together so fast!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Rin, Len, thank you for helping make the batter.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... I was sure he was going to use that roller on the batter, but he ended up attaching some sort of handle to it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It even has a little arm on it that seems to allow it to move between the tray of batter and the stove...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... The batter and that rod... It gets roasted...? Wait, that's it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, excellent. KAITO, I take it that you've figured it out?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I'll reveal the answer while getting to work on it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Robo-Nene, is the spit heated up?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes, it is ready to use whenever.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu, Nene, I'll need you to both help me for this next part.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
This is so exciting☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu, you'll be in charge of moving the roller backwards and forwards. Nene, I'll need you to spin it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So, Emu, starting with you!
Use the arm to move the roller just above the tray of batter for me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Roger! Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Good! Now, lower it into the tray.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Next, Nene! Spin the roller in such a way that the batter spreads evenly across it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay... L-Like this?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, they've added a thin layer of batter!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! What do you think they're making...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That should do it, Nene.
Emu, can you move the roller back above the flame...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, once it's hot, do I use the roller again to bake it...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Precisely!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll repeat this process and bake it one layer at a time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At first glance, this probably appears similar to how a tree gains a ring for each year it lives. Now, what delicious dessert shares that same characteristic?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tree rings...? Ah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Baumkuchen!
Baumkuchen!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's correct!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, why don't we all take turns spinning it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've designed it so that anyone can use it safely, but please be mindful of the stove.

rows.Speaker: Rin, Len & Miku
rows.Line:
Okay!
Cool☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mhm... Something smells delicious...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, you're finally awake!
Luka, let's make our Baumkuchen together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Everyone's smiling.
Thank you for preparing such a fun White Day celebration for us, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. It's the least I could do considering how much you've all done for us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui, it's getting pretty big now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let's take it off the spit and see how it tastes.
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, this is quite the dilemma...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Apologies...
I had Seiryuin give me a few tips regarding how to get into character.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Well, to be clear, not using her way, but her friend's...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, I'm worried that I won't be able to figure out my character in time if I go with that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(He only has a few days left.
His chances of reaching Seiryuin's level seem slim...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After seeing that look on his face, there was no way we weren't going to support him...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, there really isn't much we can do to help...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can give him all the advice I want as a director, but there's no point if it doesn't help him figure out how to play Rio.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What are our options aside from that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Someone's calling me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, Tsukasa, good evening.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Sorry, I know it's late.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's perfectly fine. I was just trying to come up with some ideas.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Ideas? For practice?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Correct. I assume you called for the same reason?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <I did! I tried thinking of what I can do with the days I have left, but I'm honestly at a loss.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, would you like to hear what I have? Well, to be fair, it's extremely simple.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <What?! I should limit the number of scenes I practice?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. As was explained to us, Tsukasa, each candidate will only have around three minutes to perform a scene of their choice during the audition.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I believe you should place a priority on the scenes that resonate with you the most.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Though I do agree with the notion that you need to practice every scene to get a full grasp of your character.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <But time is not on my side. On top of that, my portrayal needs to be of a certain level...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have a feeling that the others will do the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <So, the question becomes which scenes to choose...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Ideally, one that involves you, Seiryuin and a moment where you can really shine.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Obviously, you won't land the role by putting on a half-hearted performance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On the other hand, you could put aside any comparisons between you and Seiryuin when you're both on stage. Instead, you could focus only on perfecting your portrayal of Rio.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you choose that route, you could select a scene where Rio is alone or with his mother.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All of us. Regardless of what you choose, Tsukasa, you have our full support.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But figuring out your character takes top priority.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Yes, I agree...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, which scene you do will be up to you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You could conceivably practice a few different scenes, wait to see which ones the others perform during the audition and make your final decision then.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <I see... But...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <I absolutely want to practice the scene where Rio chases after the phoenix...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Yes, I had a feeling you'd pick that scene as one of your choices...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you're going to practice that scene, you'll need a practice partner. Emu could work since she's so agile...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <About that. Would it be possible to use one of those bird robots you made?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <I mean, I'm the only one of us participating in this audition. I'd appreciate her help, but you all also need time to practice.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <So, if possible, I'd like to practice on my own.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Using a bird robot as the phoenix, eh...? Okay, I'll make sure to bring it for tomorrow's practice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <T-Tomorrow?! You can have it ready that quickly?!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The truth is, I have this other robot that I was working on for a different matter.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's based on the bird robots I made before, so it'll be fairly easy to modify.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I'll take this opportunity to fiddle with the code a bit and make it behave more like a phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I know...! The motor I got my hands on just recently should give it a significant boost in mobility!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'm getting more and more ideas now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <O-Okay...? Thank you, but don't go too overboard...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I appreciate it, Tsukasa.
Now, I'd like to get to work right away, so we'll talk again tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Yes, see you tomorrow!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, I need to see if I have all the parts I'm going to need for this...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If not, I'll just have to take parts from some of the other robots. Which means...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, that's right...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello? Nene? Sorry for bothering you so late. Would you mind meeting with me early tomorrow morning?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now I have someone to be the voice of the bird-turned-phoenix robot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All that's left is for me to finish it by tomorrow morning.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, let's get started!
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, now I just need to connect Robo-Phoenix to my computer and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Based on the internal data...
Good, she appears to have become very elusive.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm glad I asked Nene to voice her too. Compared to being unvoiced, this should make it much easier to imagine what that scene is like.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I may not have actually made a connection with him yet. I mean, we're not in a forest, and the temperature and humidity feel completely different...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alas, I know that I can't ask for everything. We don't have time to visit a forest since we need to practice, so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rio spends three days and nights surviving only on water...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I shall do the same.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Because he seemed serious, I ended up agreeing with how he wanted to understand what Rio's feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He's the type of actor who likes to get on the same page emotionally as the characters he plays.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, he's bound to encounter some roles in the future where he can't recreate their respective situations.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (As simple a method as his way of getting into character is, for a high schooler to put himself through such an ordeal...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wish we could help carry the load somehow...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Isn't there a way to simulate what he needs without taking such a physical toll...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, that's it...!
A few days later
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello. Thank you all for waiting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, there you are!
So, why did you ask us to gather like this all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There's something you wanna show us, right?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes! I've brought a new weapon!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Weapon?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed! Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, those look like...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: VR goggles?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes! Using these, we'll be able to put ourselves in whatever environment or situation we like!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For example! We may be digesting away in a monster's stomach after it devoured us...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Or desperately searching for water because our bodies have been set ablaze!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: These will allow us to safely immerse ourselves in all sorts of dangerous situations!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Th-That's so cool☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes, it is cool. But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Digesting inside a monster's stomach? Being set ablaze? How exactly do we end up in those situations?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Those were just examples.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: More to the point, if used correctly, these should help us learn to play our characters better.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That sounds fun! Let's give it a try, you guys! Who wants to start?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't mind waiting since I've played plenty of these kinds of games before.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, I'm kinda scared after hearing those example scenarios...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I'll go first!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, would you mind putting these on? I'll play the video I put together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, like this...?
Okay, I think it's set!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Wh-Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Th-This is incredible!
I'm running! Across the ocean!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh?! I'm taking flight now?!
Oh, hello there...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Huh? Tsukasa, who are you talking to?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was greeting an airplane that I just flew by. I made eye contact with one of the passengers, so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seriously, what's going on in this video...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I stitched together a series of free videos. Please forgive any issues with the editing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's not what I meant...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! That was so much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear you enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I could only prepare a video this time, but it'll feel even more real when I add some sound to it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, if I can find a way to stimulate one's senses of touch and smell...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You can do that?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, not immediately...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I'd like to keep that in mind as a way to help us learn and play new characters.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As much as I like to see actors put on sensational performances, asking them to do more than they can handle would do more harm than good.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for doing this!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It was nothing.
We're troupe mates, aren't we?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Rui!
I wanna try it again!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The part where you fly might help me get a better idea of what it's like to be a duck♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, of course!
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She seems nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I suppose it's only natural since we're going to start practicing the scene where the forest's birds all begin to appear as Rio chases after the phoenix.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which includes the moment Nene appears for the very first time as the Cowardly Canary.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Good morning, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Rui, morning.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
This is it.
Today, we get to see the fruits of all your labor.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Didn't you do a lot of research in order to achieve a strong grasp of the Cowardly Canary?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is going to be your chance to see how well what you have right now fits into our show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I'm very much looking forward to seeing your performance as the Cowardly Canary.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The truth is, I'm still not happy with what I have. I'm actually a little worried...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But my plan is to use these practices to really become the Cowardly Canary before we open.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and I'll be doing the same.

rows.Speaker: Bird Cast Member
rows.Line:
Oh, Kamishiro!
I wanna practice the opening scene a bit! Mind giving me a hand?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Of course!
I'll see you again in a bit, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I'm gonna go practice too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, everyone sounds amazing!
It already feels like the real thing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, as we should expect from the cast of the Phoenix Stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And they look so natural. We stand to learn quite a lot from them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Bird Cast Member
rows.Line:
Oh, practice is about to start...
Let's all head over!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She seems to not want to waste even a second.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“H-Huh?!
Who's there...?!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “N-No, stay away...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Oh... I-I'm sorry...
But please... Go somewhere else...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I hate to break your concentration, Nene, but practice is about to start.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...? Oh, you're right.
Thanks for letting me know.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
So, shall we?
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll be going now.
See you all tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Nene's habits, eh...?)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: As for your singing, it simply won't do at this rate.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Your character sings two songs in total during this show. The second one in particular plays a vital role in changing how Rio and the phoenix view one another.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: As your current rate, you're going to struggle to move the audience. At the moment, Kusanagi, your singing sticks out just that much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In the end, we were neither able to find the root cause nor give her any usable advice...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I can help when it comes to acting, but my knowledge surrounding singing is very basic.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Because of that, Nene's been the one who's been teaching our troupe how to sing.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Did we rely on her too much...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (After all, it's a director's duty to give actors opportunities to grow...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This is very similar to what happened that other time...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I regret not putting more thought into this...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: More thought? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Until now, I kept assigning roles to Tsukasa that I thought would help bring out his potential...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: His goal in life is “to become a world-famous star”. In retrospect, I regret not pushing his boundaries by assigning him more challenging roles.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words, I regret not thinking ahead more...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I still have a long road ahead of me as a director.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I should find a solution to this problem instead of beating myself up...)
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay, everyone.
Do we all know what our tasks are?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪ We'll be making the pom-poms☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And we're gonna come up with the choreography.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's do our best, plushies♪

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's wonderful to see so many of you here.

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: We're here because we wanna give Nene our support!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: We promise to become really good dancers!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you very much. But I'm hoping that you enjoy yourselves, so let's all try to have fun with this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed! After all, this video is meant to cheer Nene up and give her a boost of encouragement!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Everyone sounds so motivated considering how quickly we decided to implement KAITO's idea.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But it seems that we all want to do what we can for Nene right now.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, let's show her that we're here for her! Let's send her all the cheers and words of encouragement we can!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, would you mind working with KAITO on hammering out all the details for our video?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everyone, please feel free to ask Tsukasa, KAITO or myself if you have any questions.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Okay☆
Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu, how's your group doing?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, Rui!
Look! We already have a ton made☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: These pom-poms are for us, and the ones Luka and Miku are making are for the plushies!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Aren't they so fluffy and adorably tiny☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, they look wonderful.
Keep up the good work and we should have enough for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe... These pom-poms are so fluffy... They feel so much like sheep that...
*Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Luka, hang in there!
Just a few more!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, take this! An anti-sleepyhead pom-pom attack! Feel the fluffiness!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That tickles.
But I do feel much more awake now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everyone, how's the choreography coming along?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Great! We came up with something really cute☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They're gonna wave their hands while cheering and jumping in the air!

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line:
Look! Look!
Go! Go! Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line:
You can do it, Nene♪
Boing! Boing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You've certainly come up with a fun and energy-filled routine. The pom-poms should add a very nice touch.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Woohoo♪
Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Rui, you're here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How are the others doing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, they seem to be doing just fine, if not having fun at the same time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, also. We were trying to come up with a way to really surprise Nene. Do you have any ideas?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You just saw what the choreography is going to look like, right? Any suggestions?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They're gonna wave their hands while cheering and jumping in the air!

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line:
You can do it, Nene♪
Boing! Boing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I think I have a fun idea.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone! Are you all ready?!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, let's begin filming and have fun just like we rehearsed.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, I'm hitting record in...
Five... Four... Three...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hiii, Neneee!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
How's singing practice going?!
I hope you're not feeling too lonely.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I forgot. Robo-Nene's at home with you, right?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Emu, wait!
You're getting off track!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahem...
Today, Nene, we're putting this video together in the hopes that it'll give you some encouragement!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We hope you get to watch this.
Now, it's showtime!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Go! Go! Nene!

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushies
rows.Line: Boing! You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushies
rows.Line: We're all rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, the plushies are jumping so well☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Their routine has become just that much more dynamic thanks to the trampoline Rui suggested we use.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A wonderful idea indeed! It's hard not to smile!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. There were some jumps already in the original routine, so I simply used that as a springboard.

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: Yaaay! Boing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, that seems a bit too...!

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: O-Oh nooo! I-I'm flying too hiiigh!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Got you...! Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: Yup! Thanks for catching me, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Now, let's wave at the camera.

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: We believe in you, Nene! You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: You can do it! We're all rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui with some nice ad-libbing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, an excellent save!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Alright, get ready♪
We're up next☆

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Despite the usual weather around this time, we've got clear skies and ample sunlight today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Robo-Nene, do you copy?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene's Voice
rows.Line: <Yes, I can hear you.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Please calculate the sun's position and adjust the hose accordingly. We'll activate in fifteen minutes.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene's Voice
rows.Line: <Roger.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm heading over now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, all that's left is to check the hose attached to Robo-Nene...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, there you are!
Hey Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello Mizuki, I didn't realize you were at school today. Did you come here for a quick nap?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. I'd love to since the weather is nice and all.
But I actually have something more fun in mind♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, what are you guys waiting for? Hurry up and get over here!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You guys...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hello Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Apologies for bothering you during lunch.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, so you brought company. Did you come here to have lunch together?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've just finished up here, so feel free to use the space.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh... Please wait, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're all here because we have something to tell you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Something to tell me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup♪ Big smiles, everybody! C'mon Li'l Bro, you too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
We're a day early, but...
Happy birthday, Rui!

rows.Speaker: An, Akito, & Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You all came here just to wish me a happy birthday?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Sure did!
But hey! Rui, don't you have anything better to say?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, of course.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Phew! Good thing I remembered that it's your birthday this weekend. That was a close one, right, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito and Toya were the ones who said, “Since we're all here today, let's go wish him a happy birthday!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, don't go making things up. You and Akiyama dragged us along without saying anything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's because you would've made a mad dash as soon as we told you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It's his birthday, I wouldn't have been against it. He's helped us out sometimes, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's rather unfortunate that we didn't have enough time to prepare a gift.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Speaking of which, Mizuki, why didn't you tell us earlier?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's what I was saying before. I only remembered last night.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, please don't worry about it. I appreciate the sentiment more than anything.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I find that hard to believe coming from you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. After Akiyama reached out to us, I also invited Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it seemed like she was being mindful of us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... Our troupe is throwing a birthday party to celebrate tomorrow, so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Please, go ahead and celebrate without me. I'm sure it would make Rui really happy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Really? Nene said that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She was most likely half being considerate and half anxious about being with people she's not so familiar with.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Will you be having the party at your house, Kamishiro?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, we've got a small venue booked. We're planning to celebrate after our rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? You're still going to practice on your birthday? You really do love shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well I'd say that also applies to Tsukasa and the others. After all, we are all show addicts.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I'm certain that you and your troupe will make many more people smile with your shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, that is what we're striving for.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: By the way, what were you doing up here? You didn't look like you were in the middle of eating lunch...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? The last few days have been rainy and humid, no? Since it's such a wonderful day outside, I was simply enjoying the sunlight.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? You really think we're going to believe that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kamishiro... I don't really want to have to tell you this, but if you're planning on doing something bad then please confess now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I would never do such a thing. I'm merely a director who just wishes to put smiles on people's faces.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On that note, if you all stay here for a little longer you'll soon witness something delightful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something...delightful?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I knew it! You are planning something!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, c'mon on now! Since it's his birthday tomorrow, how about we let this one slide♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then everyone, I will now be taking my leave!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Voice
rows.Line: Thank you for the birthday wishes!
Schoolyard

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Apologies for the wait, Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Calculations and adjustments completed.
Ready for activation.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I knew I could count on you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Seems like the hose is perfectly attached to your arm. Excellent.
We are all set to go.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Engaging...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Here we go. Let's start the countdown!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Initiating in five seconds...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Three... Two... One...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Fire!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa! Hey, look down there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I think that brings today's student council meeting to...hm?
Rain? On a sunny day like this?

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: You're right. But it only seems to be raining in the schoolyard...

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: What? That doesn't sound right...

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys! Look outside!
It's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Pretty?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So this is what Rui meant by delightful, huh.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... What a beautiful rainbow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We did it. With this, we'll be able to have rainbows in our shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, Robo-Nene. Let's leave before the teachers catch us.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Roger.
Rui's Birthday
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, everyone. Let's do this just like we practiced.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, it seems like everyone is already here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ah! Hey Rui!
Let's give it our best again today♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ I can't wait for the birthday party after practice!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I'm also looking forward to AFTER practice!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: C-C'mon Rui. Don't just stand there, let's get ready.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “What's this? It appears that you've brought quite the flock with you, Mr. Inspector.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Yes. Today is the day I will finally capture you, Phantom Thief Ladron!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Ladron? Just another word for robber, hm? I beg that you stop with these painful nicknames.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Silence! I'll have you know it's rather befitting for lowly scum such as yourself!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “All of you! Cease him with all of your might!”

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: “Yeah!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Hehe. Careful now. The area around you is bit dark. Allow me to shed some light for you...”

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: “W-W-WHOA!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Ack! What is this light?! It's blinding me!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Hehehe. Ciao, Mr. Inspector♪”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everything is going well so far. Now it's time to initiate our plan.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ Here we go, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “We have you cornered, Phantom Thief Ladron.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “To think that my clients were actually working for you all this time... I suppose you got me.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Interesting. You've gone awfully quiet for once. Where has your usual vigor gone?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “I could say the same for you, Mr. Inspector. You're not one to think twice before charging in head first.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Well...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “You learned the truth, didn't you? That I've only been stealing to help those orphans.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “And those gadgets you caught me with...were used to save the children from the clutches of criminals...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Sir... If we arrest him, those kids will...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “She has a point. Those criminals might try to go after the kids again...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Arrest me, if you so wish.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “What?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Those without power in this city have suffered for years. But things only began to change when people with a sense of justice like you arrived...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Arrest me and you'll be crowned a hero overnight. With that reputation... I hope that you can change this city—”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I don't take orders from the likes of a thief!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I became an officer to save and protect the weak! Who am I to rip away the only beacon of hope they have?!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Sir! Does this mean—”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is what I thought, but now I'm determined to put you in handcuffs!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Huh? The inspector was supposed to let the thief go and propose joining forces to defeat the evil that lurks in the city together...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We cannot afford to let you escape today! All because...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If we do, we won't be able to celebrate your birthday!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Would you please do the honors, plushies?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Feast on this! Plushie shower!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From above?! Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehehe. Don't forget that we're here too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We've got you, Rui♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Operation plushie snuggle storm was a success!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay everyone, on the count of three♪ One, two...three☆

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Rui!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Heh... Hehe, hehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I'm also looking forward to AFTER practice!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I see now. They were trying to throw me off by emphasizing “after.”)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You all got me. I never would've expected a surprise in the middle of rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Hurray! It was a success!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We did it, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Out of the way, coming through! Here it is☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rui! We prepared you a birthday cake♪ Now go ahead and blow the candles!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't mind if I do...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rui, happy birthday☆

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Looking forward to another year with you, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rui! Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An, Akito & Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Kamishiro, I heard that you did an experiment that created a big rainbow in the schoolyard! Just thinking about the possibility of you using it on the Wonder Stage makes me excited!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm also looking forward to it. I am certain that it will make your shows even more wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How carefree... Well the rainbow was pretty and there were loads of people taking photos of it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Speaking of, just as I thought we'd pulled off a great surprise for you, you went and one-upped us like that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Who would've thought? By the way Kamishiro, as a hall monitor, I need to ask you to please keep those to a minimum, okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui! Once again, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe☆ The birthday surprise was a success!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It was. It's not every day you get to see a surprised look like that on Rui's face.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, yes. A testament to my flawless acting skills, honed through years of hardship.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, it is thanks to you and the others that I've been able to keep improving. I'm looking forward to another year with you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: From blazing fires to flashing lightning, let's keep doing lots of fun effects, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll keep pushing myself in any way I can. I'm looking forward to other interesting effects you come up with.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From school to rehearsal, today's just been one surprise after another.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wonder... Is this something that everyone experiences? I've rarely been on the receiving end of a surprise, so I wasn't really sure how to react.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, I believe it is now my turn to render everyone speechless.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll continue to do my best to keep putting on outstanding shows, so I hope you look forward to them.
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: These drones... No, I'll have to leave them behind. And my maintenance toolkit...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I won't need that either since it's not like Robo-Nene will be going with us...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's good that I've started packing for the school trip, but I can't quite seem to decide what to take...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe I should look over that list again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Let's see... My phone's a must, of course.
The guidebook with our schedule, cash, my student ID...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A few changes of clothes, toiletries, writing utensils and some basic medicines just in case...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Along similar lines, some wrenches, a screwdriver, wire cutters, solder, circuit boards and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I haven't finished reading these books... They're not on the list, but it may be nice to have some books to read while on the bullet train.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My ideas notebooks too, just in case I see or think of something interesting...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
My bag won't close...
No, what if I pressed harder?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, we're here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hello, Rui.>

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line: <Thanks for having us☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You left your door open.
What are you...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, your floor's completely covered in all these different things.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I've never seen some of these parts before.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Were you doing something, or have these always been here...?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Oh, I know♪
You asked us all to gather to help you clean☆ Right?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Not quite...
I was packing for our school trip.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You were packing? That doesn't exactly explain why we can't see the floor. Keeping things tidy has never been your strong point, has it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
There's no room for us in here.
How are we gonna watch the video of the 30th Anniversary Show...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Sorry, I'll clean this up now.
Let me move these out of the way first so you can all enter...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, wait, stop! Don't move a muscle!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There, now we can enter!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Ah, much better. Nice work.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But there's this pile still left.
You said you were packing for the school trip, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Those are all things I was thinking about taking with me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is actually much less compared to what I originally had. When we went over to the United States, I took quite a few things that I didn't end up using.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But this pile's huge... I mean, do you really need to bring all these tools along? It's not like you're gonna be doing maintenance on Robo-Nene while you're over there.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I know, but I was thinking, “What if I need them just in case?”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Just in case?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, for example, if the bullet train were to break down...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even if that were to happen, the rail company's repair crew should be handling that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, what if the emergency sprinklers where we're staying malfunction and—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The teachers and staff will do something about that. Why are you under the impression that you have to fix everything yourself...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because it would cause everyone a lot of trouble if I didn't.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, Rui's our knight in shining armor.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, that's so nice of you☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that is kind of him...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But you won't have room for souvenirs and such if your bag is this full from the start.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What?! You've gotta make room for memories!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, Rui, you should try to have as much fun as you can on this trip...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you both very much...
I agree...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: H-Haha. Sorry, I know this is all happening really suddenly... It's also probably pretty obvious that I'm not exactly the outgoing type, so... I-If you don't want to join us, we'll understand!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: But it would be nice to have you in our group, Kamishiro...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Yes, this trip may finally give me a chance to...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As worried as I am about certain unfortunate occurrences, it's probably best for me to leave some of these behind...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If possible, would you all mind advising me on what I should or should not take...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
