rows.Line: Of course! First, we're taking out all of these tools!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What...?! All of them? But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're not gonna use this soldering iron or these circuit boards. Emu, can you put these on that shelf for me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, but...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Now take out all these notebooks...
Um... You have one for directing and one for story writing?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You have so many different notebooks, Rui.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I understand your reasoning, but you could bring just one for this trip. You could also cut and paste your notes into the right book when you get home. How does that sound?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, KAITO, you're right...
One would make things quite a bit easier.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, these too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Books...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
...!
I was going to read those on the bullet train.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You were? Then, that seems fine.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank goodness.
I was worried that you were also going to toss those out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You give us far too little credit.
All we're trying to do is whittle this down to the bare essentials for your trip.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, that should do it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! Your bag feels so much lighter now☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I don't believe it...
Just this for three days and two nights?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I really think I should take some tools—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Nope!
You'll just have to do with the ones you keep hidden in your pockets.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree!
So, put that wrench down!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Miku & Co.
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I hope you have lots and lots of fun on this trip, Rui☆>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We'll be looking forward to seeing what you bring back♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Now now...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you all very much...
I promise to have as much fun as I can.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it's getting late, so why don't we start watching the video of the anniversary show?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: <Woohoo!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you all for helping me with this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It was our pleasure.
Now, let's get that projector we set aside back out.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Oh, Kamishiro! Morning!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, good morning.
Hayashi, Taniyama, morning to you two as well.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Hey. Oh, Kamishiro, have you been sleeping okay since the school trip?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me? Yes, rather well since I felt very tired when I got home...

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
Right?
Miyake here said he felt lonely and couldn't sleep at all.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Th-That's because we were all in the same room and played cards and had pillow fights and stuff together... My mind was ready for more, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Those two nights were very fun.

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: A pair of kings! No one's gonna top that...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I can. A pair of aces.
That's it for me.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!
You're the president, Kamishiro?!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
No...!
You didn't cheat, did you?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Who knows?

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
What's the big idea, Kamishiro...?
Those landed right on top of us...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Yeah, what he said!
We're fighting for Tenma now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? I thought we were supposed to fight as individuals. Three versus one seems a bit unfair, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No matter...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Miyake, you're my last hope.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Huh?!
What do you mean?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All of it made for good memories. Including having to write letters of apology.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Hey, that's the spirit...!
The Weirdo Wombo Combo knows what's up!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Should you really be praising them for that?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Haha... Oh, also! Kamishiro, you bought a ton of souvenirs. Did you give them to your family already...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, quite a few friends and acquaintances as well.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
You bought that weird mutsuhashi too.
Were those also a gift?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, the grapefruit-flavored mutsuhashi gummies? Yes, they were. I'm looking forward to hearing how they taste.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: I bought some of those too. My family actually kind of enjoyed them.

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Did you have any?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Uhh... N-No, because everyone else liked them so much. I felt bad eating them...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? It's unusual for someone to buy their family a snack they haven't actually tried.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Hey, cut me some slack.
What about you, Kamishiro? Did you try them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I didn't.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
What?!
Then, quit pulling my chain!

rows.Speaker: Rui, Miyake, Taniyama & Hayashi
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha!
Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That trip really was way too much fun...

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Yeah, I actually didn't think I'd enjoy it all that much.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Same... The ones I went on in elementary school and junior high were also really fun... But this was hands down the best.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Especially since I didn't have that many friends in junior high. Even when I was with my group, I felt like I was all alone.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you mean... I had friends, but they were all in different classes...

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: It is pretty rare to be put in a class with people you get on with like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This school trip also ended up being the most fun for me.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Actually, Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: So, um...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: We're still gonna be friends moving forward, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I should be thanking you for inviting me into your group.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Haha. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: We're happy to have you.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Let's keep having tons of fun together!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As I just mentioned, you becoming freelancers poses many problems for us.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: However, we're also not in a position to force you to stay on your current contracts.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
We'll consider your proposal...
Let us hope that it works out for both parties in the end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We weren't able to reach a resolution, but our discussion still ended up being quite worthwhile.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Especially since they agreed to allow me to invite Emu on this endeavor.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But whether or not she agrees is ultimately up to her.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When the time comes for them to say that they wish to leave the Wonder Stage, will you try to follow in their footsteps?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nope.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because my dream is to protect Grandpa's amusement park and keep it the way it is.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And make a place where everyone smiles!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Emu deeply cares about Phoenix Wonderland, from the bottom of her heart...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I shouldn't get in the way of her dream...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I want the four of us to make our dreams come true together. I don't want to give up on that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What am I supposed to do in this situation...?
Huh? Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Are you heading back to the Wonder Stage?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We thought you were gonna go straight home after you took care of that thing you were talking about. I just said bye to the others after finishing up practice and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(I'm at Phoenix Wonderland...?
But why? I thought I was on my way home...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(This isn't good...
I can't seem to get the conversation I had with her brothers out of my mind.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've finished doing that thing I mentioned, but I got the feeling I'd left something here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Want me to help you look?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, thank you. I should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu, there's something I'd like to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would it be possible for us to talk tomorrow...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tomorrow? Not now...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
This matter also involves Tsukasa and Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I'd like to discuss it when we're all present.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll let you know once I have a better idea of when we can all meet. For now, see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: See you then♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My hope is that I'll get the same sort of positive response tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I can't bring myself to give up being with them.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I've finally found the best of friends in Tsukasa, Nene and Emu.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, I'm going to spend every second I have left to think of a way for us to stay together while pursuing our dreams.)
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
How long has it been since we last cried so much?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We should cool our faces off when we get home if we don't want them to swell up tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But I'm glad...
The four of us get to keep doing shows together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'm also really glad.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, don't you have more to say than just that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm listening. I wasn't trying to be curt.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Though, I was also thinking about something else.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Something else...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. About our show, of course.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The anniversary show we'll be doing for Phoenix Wonderland will be our last as members of its cast.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You really are a show maniac, huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, lemme guess, you just came up with an interesting idea for a stunt?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, actually... I was just thinking that we could change the ending slightly.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all, it's supposed to be about us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, true.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, what did you have...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? A message...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, it's from Tsukasa.
“Can we meet a little earlier than usual tomorrow?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I don't mind...
But what could this be about?
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, thank you all for coming!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez... How are you able to shout like that so early in the morning?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene! Are you still feeling sleepy?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?! Emu, why are you copying him?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because it looked like fun!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, I wasn't finished speaking!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So, Tsukasa!!!
Why did you ask us to gather so early?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ugh...! Stop being so obnoxious, you guys!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahem.
Now, as for why we're here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's about “The Traveling Troupe”, the show we'll be doing for the anniversary show. I was thinking that we could change the ending a little.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
This is perfect.
I was also thinking yesterday about making the same suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I should expect no less from our director! I take it you also felt somewhat unsure about how it currently ends?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You mean the line, “And they made shows together forever after”...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. As things stand, that ending is not entirely inaccurate.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I feel that there's a happy ending out there which reflects us better.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Like the one from the show that MEIKO and the others did for us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, I was thinking...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This show is going to be the last one we do as cast members of Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu's brothers also mentioned that they'll announce us leaving to become freelancers beforehand...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So what if we changed things around a little to make it sound more like, “We'll be back bigger and better than before!” You know, for everyone there to see us...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's an amazing idea!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was actually a little worried that some of the visitors would be sad to hear that they won't get to see us do shows anymore.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But if we can tell them that we'll be back...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, I believe we're in agreement.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's come up with a new happy ending for “The Traveling Troupe”.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu & Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I came to ask Tsukasa if he wanted to eat lunch together, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems he's hard at work ahead of our session after school.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I...might be held back a year!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There are going to be supplementary classes all through next week, and there's a test on the last day that will determine whether I'm held back or not.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've swallowed my pride to ask something of you. Please, help me study!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'm not surprised that Tsukasa's already started studying by lunch break.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd hate to distract him, so I suppose I'll go to the school store alone.
Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, hello Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Excuse me for approaching you out of the blue. Do you have a moment?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I do indeed. How can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There's something I'd like to ask you about.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ask me? Hm... Would you care to share?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Certainly. Akito and Shiraishi have been placed in supplementary classes, and they're at risk of being held back a year.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The classes will be held every day this week after school, starting today. I know that they've brought this on themselves by being inattentive to their studies.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If possible, I would like to make sure they enter second year alongside me, not only as my teammates, but also as my cherished friends.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And for that reason...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm here because I would greatly appreciate it if you could help me, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For one thing, you're far more intelligent than I am. Also...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You have taught me many things in the past, and always in very easy-to-understand terms.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is that so?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Take, for example, the time I was an extra in that wedding ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, yes. We put on a wonderful show thanks to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I had no acting experience, but I carried out that role thanks to your guidance, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe that the ability to give such guidance is an innate talent of yours.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And that's why, if it's not too much trouble, I'm asking for your help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you, Aoyagi. Any praise of my work is always welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I want to help him if I can. He's been my junior for almost a year now.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I have a previous engagement... It might be difficult to help Aoyagi too.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But, no...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How about we take a group photo together?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'd like to have something to commemorate this day with.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, sorry about that. I was lost in thought.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As it turns out, Tsukasa has also been placed in supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa has?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. And I've already promised to help him study, so I was thinking just now that it may be hard to also help you out this time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I...see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I have a suggestion...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What if we all gather in one location for a study session?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A study session...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It would be easy to meet up after school since we'd have access to empty classrooms.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course, I'd have to be the one helping Tsukasa as I'm in his year, but I'd still be able to help you three.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But, wouldn't that be asking a lot of you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Think nothing of it. Besides...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The school year is almost over, which means we'll soon be third-years, and you'll all be second-years.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think it might be a good occasion to make some memories.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Making memories...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you're right. It's a wonderful idea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, isn't it just? However, let's keep what I just said between you and me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The stakes are high for the others, with the threat of being held back looming over them. If they knew what I was thinking, it might not be well received.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Will you tell Tsukasa about the study group?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'll speak to him later. We can hammer out the details when we meet after school.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Understood. Thank you for agreeing to this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Well... It really isn't like me to suggest something like making memories with a study session.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then, I'd better go prepare. After all, our friends' academic futures hang in the balance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I know I said all that, but...
With their grades at stake, I need to be responsible.
After the closing ceremony
Diner

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, everyone! Do you have your glasses?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tsukasa, could you please use your indoor voice?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ahaha... We sure are getting a lot of looks from other tables.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph. That was supposed to be my indoor voice... It seems people can't help but be drawn in by my voice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Perhaps your enunciation is so well trained that your voice carries without you thinking about it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ahaha! Whaddya expect from a professional actor?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's no need to praise me so much. Even still, I don't want to be a bother to other customers. Could someone take my place?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How about Rui? He's in the same year as you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose I could. Though, I'd hate to steal the limelight when you three are the ones who made it through the supplementary classes...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No no no, that doesn't matter! Go on, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh well. It's hard to say no to my junior.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everyone, well done on making it through a tough week. Although it's somewhat belated, let's enjoy this little after-party!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On that note, cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akiyama, would you mind sharing some of your French fries with us?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sure thing! Grab me some serving plates!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you! We appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, what...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kamishiro... You've been really focused for a while now. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I'm removing the vegetables from this pizza.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, do you not eat vegetables?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I do not. It is beyond my comprehension what anyone sees in these things.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Guess that hasn't changed. Wanna trade your broccoli for my salami?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I would be happy to. Thank you, Mizuki. Don't mind if I do...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, I heard from Mizuki that you three might have to leave partway through. Are you still okay for time?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that's okay! My dad canceled practice for today and told us to spend time with our friends!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He said, “They stayed back after school for a whole week for you, so go hang out with them.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm going to get a drink. Where's the juice bar?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I saw it by the entrance.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Safe travels♪
I recommend a melon soda and cola mocktail! It's one part—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, don't go giving him weird ideas.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll go with you, Aoyagi. I'd like to get a soup refill.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, let's go together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, by the way. I wanted to say something to you, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To me? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wanted to thank you again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Both the study session and this after-party have been very fun. Also...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here you go!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An, I'm rooting for you to make it into second year armed with this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you, Mizuki! I'll make good use of it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've seen new sides to everyone, and it's been a very good experience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I want to thank you for coming to me about the supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's me who should be thanking you, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's thanks to you and Mizuki that Akito and Shiraishi are going to join me in second year.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I'm truly grateful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not to mention... This has all made for a memorable end to my first year, too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Then I'm glad. That makes two of us coming out of this having made some memories.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like we're missing out on the fun over there.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It does indeed. Why don't we go back and join them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now then...
I got what I wanted, so it's time to head home.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still, I feel very fortunate that this shopping mall was carrying what I was looking for.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Shopping mall bookstores tend to carry a lot of stuff related to the entertainment industry, but to think I'd find something so technical...)
Huh? Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, what a coincidence.
Are you also on your way home, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I just finished meeting everyone on my committee. I needed a quick break, so I decided to take a little detour...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The bag you're carrying is from the bookstore in the mall, right? What did you buy?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, it's the translated version of a book from abroad about directing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa, it's as thick as a dictionary! And the print's tiny...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Translations of this kind of book always end up having the most difficult sentences. I'd have a lot of trouble getting through it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you've just breezed through them since we were little...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's not that I breezed through them...
I've experienced enough of them now that they feel familiar.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In particular, when it came to mechanical engineering, books from overseas typically taught me the most.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, you did used to read a lot of books on machines and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I feel that you've been reading more books about directing lately...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's because the current me needs to know more about both directing and inventing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Naturally, I still put effort into making anything that supports my directing, but I've started prioritizing learning recently...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The more I know about past events and various technologies, the more options I'll have when faced with similar concepts in show business.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This past year helped me realize that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I think I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You've also been reading quite a bit lately, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seiryuin said that she always reads books during a show's rehearsal process so that she can better understand her character and the background of the story.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I never really put that level of effort in before, but now I have no choice but to follow her example...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's wonderful to hear.
However...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It moves me to see how the girl who spent all her time reading picture books has moved on to more difficult texts.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Picture books? How far back in time are you going...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm a high schooler now. It's normal for me to read difficult books.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We've both come such a long way...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Remember how we used to play a lot and share books with each other?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We were both so enthralled by that rendition of The Little Mermaid that we couldn't stop talking about it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We even tried making our own shows together... You acted and I directed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Looking back, it was a bit similar to playing house...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But now, we're finally pursuing our dreams from back them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How incredible is that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It is...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The shows we did back then only involved the two of us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But now our numbers have grown.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
This past year ended up being a momentous turning point for us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the climax of the show that is our lives is still yet to come.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On that day, I hope we'll be able to shine as brightly as possible. I'm looking forward to experiencing it together with you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know what you're going on about...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Whatever it is, I hope so too.
Let's go make our dreams come true.
Kamiyama High School - Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Greening Committee Chairman
rows.Line: Alright, welcome to the first official meeting of this year's greening committee.

rows.Speaker: Greening Committee Chairman
rows.Line: Aside from the new students, I'm seeing quite a few familiar faces here today...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
Many of the members from last year seem to be here, including myself.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Greening Committee Member A
rows.Line: I have this sort of attachment to the plants I've been taking care of. I feel like I should look after them until I graduate.

rows.Speaker: Third-Year Greening Committee Member A
rows.Line:
I get what you mean...
And things have become a lot easier since you joined, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Greening Committee Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, the flower beds aren't getting all messed up anymore thanks to you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I really don't feel as if I did anything special...
But I appreciate your kind words.

rows.Speaker: Third-Year Greening Committee Member B
rows.Line: Of course. Let's do our best again this year, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This committee has changed so much.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (When I first joined, everyone's attitude toward me didn't exactly feel welcoming...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I'm grateful that they've grown to understand me now...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Although...)

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line:
Hey, isn't that him?
He's one of the Weirdo Wombo Combo...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: He flies drones and performs dangerous experiments at school, right? Why's he on the quiet and peaceful greening committee...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Well, I can't blame them for feeling that way...)

rows.Speaker: Greening Committee Chairman
rows.Line:
...
Kamishiro, I have a favor to ask you.
Would you mind telling the new students about what we do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: Greening Committee Chairman
rows.Line: They probably don't know much about the flower beds, the farm, or other aspects of this committee yet, so I figured you could explain since you're the most well-informed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line:
Y-You don't have to do that for us!
We can learn as we go...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Understood.
It would be my pleasure to teach you all about the committee.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everyone, would you mind coming with me?

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: O-Okay...
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: I can't believe we have to work with the person at the center of all those rumors...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: My friend's big brother even warned me to avoid dealing with him no matter what...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're here. Listen up, everyone.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The greening committee is responsible for all of the flower beds you see here in the courtyard.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Most of our duties involve tilling the dirt and planting new flowers, with a different person watering them each day.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We actually just planted the seeds for those flowers over there a few months ago. It's good to see them finally sprouting.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: Wow, you guys planted the seeds for these?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, please be careful when touching them. It's difficult to see, but we laid out a net in front of them.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line:
Whoa, he's right...!
I didn't notice at all. The mesh pattern almost makes it look like a spider web...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: But what's its purpose...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This flower bed's been through quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The tennis and softball teams kept hitting balls this way, which led to many flowers getting crushed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wanted to protect the flowers while not obstructing the view, so I ended up going with a design that would be difficult to see...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: Wait, Kamishiro, you made this...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I did.
I felt so bad for the poor flowers.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line:
...
The guy that conducts all those dangerous experiments feels bad for flowers...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh...
This one appears to have wilted.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: Oh, that one is definitely done for. It might be a good idea to pull it out so it doesn't steal nutrients from the other flowers...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll move this flower to a separate planter for now and personally look after it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'll return it once it has fully recovered.
I bet it prefers to be with its friends...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line:
...
I'm gonna do my best for this committee.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Greening Committee Members
rows.Line: Please teach us all you can!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. Please feel free to ask me any questions you have during these meetings or even outside of them.
Shunmeiza - Production Office

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Production Associate
rows.Line: ...and that about covers it. The production team is involved in just about every essential part of any given play.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Between scheduling, budgeting, meeting with the other teams, creating flyers, running the ticket office on the day of the performances, lunch catering...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You have quite a lot to do.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Production Associate
rows.Line: It is. Things do get a little hectic sometimes... But they're all things that need to be taken care of in order for a show to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Production Associate
rows.Line: We feel a great sense of responsibility knowing that what we do determines whether or not we're going to be one hundred percent ready to deliver on the day.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Production Associate
rows.Line: So, whenever the audience goes home smiling...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Production Associate
rows.Line: Not only the actors and the director, but we also get to feel proud of what we accomplished!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It sounds like you love your job very much.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Production Associate
rows.Line: I do! Seeing the audience smile and have fun fills me with the same satisfaction that the actors and directors feel!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Seeing the audience smile...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our visit with the production team was really fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it was nice to see how passionate they all were about what they do. I'm very much looking forward to our next stop now.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line:
Wait!
Please watch your step. There's an unfinished prop by your feet.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! We're sorry!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This looks like...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Pardon me, but is this a novel that will be in the protagonist's home during the next show?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line:
Oh, aren't you two here visiting us?
We heard that you were interested in how the production process works and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, we're from the troupe Wonderlands×Showtime.
My name is Rui Kamishiro. It's a pleasure to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm Emu Otori! It's nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: Yes, nice to meet you both.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm the director for our troupe and also make quite a lot of our props. As such, I'm very interested in seeing how you make yours.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If it's alright with you, would you mind telling us more about your creative process?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
I was actually just about to go on break.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: Still, I'm amazed that you could tell this prop was for the next show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It felt like something that would be in the protagonist's house...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A starving novelist desperately working to finish his manuscript next to a disordered pile of books...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This truly felt like one of those books.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: You mean that? I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: Our job as designers is to make the audience believe that everything on stage is the real thing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The real thing...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Then, this book has certainly accomplished that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (When I initially saw it, I didn't see it as a prop.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I simply saw it as a book from that novelist's house.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
This really is remarkable...
Every crease and stain looks so real...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It has me imagining Kishi spilling a drink near it at one point in time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, I thought that too!
I thought about him panicking and trying to clean it up in a really big hurry!

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: Hehe. It means a lot to hear how much of an image it conjured up.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: As you both described, creases and stains like these can flesh out the setting of a play...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: And that's why, even if the audience doesn't see every little prop, we don't want to cut any corners.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The devil is in the details, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Yes, it can be hard sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: But the things we make elevate the actors' performance, and seeing the audience at the edge of their seats makes all that fatigue go away.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: In other words, we do everything we can for our actors and the audience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For the actors and the audience...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They're incredible. Not just their artistic skills...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They care about the details. They passionately want to bring the characters to life and entertain their audience. That much is clear.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This is what it means to be a true professional...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I hope I get to create sets and props with artisans like these someday.)
Shunmeiza - Studio

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Staff A
rows.Line: Alright, we'll start taking the set down!

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Staff B
rows.Line: Okay, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Phew... Things are finally starting to settle down.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It sounded like the others are going to need a little more time to get changed, so I might take a quick break here.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still, Tsukasa's performance this time around was nothing like his other ones...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That must've been...)
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Nice work today, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mr. Kato, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This ended up being a wonderful experience for all of us. We really appreciate you allowing us to be a part of your show.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear that. I can't help but smile whenever I get to do a show with young people who are so passionate about theatre.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I have a feeling that putting on a show with you and your friends opened this troupe's eyes to a variety of things.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: In other words, inviting Wonderlands×Showtime over to perform with Shunmeiza was an excellent decision.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: And I got to witness something rather nice...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nice?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm talking about Tenma.
He's a little rough around the edges, but he has that spark.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Catching a glimpse of his growth on the stage was quite something.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
I'm always surprised at how quickly he continues to grow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Although, he had some trouble with his role for this show...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I know. I did give him a fairly difficult task. However...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: He was able to figure out what he needed to do much faster than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Which allowed him to “become” his character.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I felt the same way...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In that instant... He'd truly disappeared into Nakayama.)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: He reminded me how actors really are an interesting breed.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: And... I have a feeling that the sky's the limit for him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'm of the same opinion.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa just keeps finding ways to get better and better...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which means I need to do the same as his director.)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Ah, while we're on the subject, I heard that you've directed just about all of your troupe's shows. Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Interesting. In that case...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I told Tenma that I took the time to watch several of your troupe's shows. As such, have had the chance to observe your work as the director.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: And I have to say, Kamishiro, you seem to come up with the most stunning effects.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: It's obvious that you want everybody in the audience to experience something new, smile and have fun. That much is clear from your work.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Not only that, the actors you work with all seem to have a spring in their step.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: That to me is proof that you know how to allow them to shine their brightest on stage. You have that sixth sense, so to speak.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much...
I'm honored by your words.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: And I'm curious to see how you grow as a director moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I hope you get to learn and experience many more new things in the future as you hone your craft.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. Me too.
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I never expected to hear such praise from Shunmeiza's director.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm surprised...but also incredibly happy. I mean, he just validated my ideas.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He saw that I want everybody in the audience to experience something new, smile and have fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's wonderful to hear from someone like him that he understands what I'm trying to do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Not only that, the actors you work with all seem to have a spring in their step.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: That to me is proof that you know how to allow them to shine their brightest on stage. You have that sixth sense, so to speak.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If my directing skills can help everyone shine on stage...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then I'll keep doing everything I can to make them radiant.
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Phew. I'm finally done doing maintenance on these props.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I never thought that we'd get a chance to appear in a film.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: The movie I'm about to work on is also going to include a few others from Shunmeiza...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
But they still need more extras.
So, if you'd like, would you all like to apply to be in it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We decided to apply to become extras after hearing about it from Bakuno...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But we ended up celebrating after we found out that we'd been accepted.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah hah! Wonderlands×Showtime will be making its big debut on the silver screen!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, this is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know we're just gonna be playing roles like a girl having a picnic or a man admiring flowers, but we should still do our best.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed. We may be extras, but we're still going to be people who live in the world of the story...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm going to do the best job I can of squatting while admiring flowers as Young Man A!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Incidentally, I just found out that Bakuno will be performing in the scene we appear in.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Screen acting is supposed to be way different from stage acting, but I can't wait to see how Bakuno does.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, me too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to seeing how films are actually made♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know we're only gonna be on set for a day, but I wanna learn as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like we're all looking forward to this experience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Emu's brothers gave us a chance to work with Shunmeiza, and now we've been given this opportunity thanks to one of their actors...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, we're lucky to have been able to establish such a network.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (On top of learning as much as we can from the opportunities they've given us, I hope we get to repay everyone someday...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, I'll go through the script one last time before I go to bed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The film we're going to be a part of is being directed by someone called Tomomi Ohara.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (After doing some quick research, I found that he doesn't employ big plot twists or anything of the sort in his films. His works seem to be mostly subdued stories that carefully explore his characters' feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Including this one. The protagonist has all but given up on life, but someone calling herself his long-lost sister suddenly appears before him. And he begins to change as a result. It's a drama that explores human relationships.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which explains why he asked Bakuno to play the protagonist. This kind of story is his forte.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (What we saw him do on stage was spectacular, to put it mildly.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (His performance made his character feel like a real-life person...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Just like Nene, I'm also looking forward to seeing what he does for this film.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (As well as how he and the director are going to work together.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If we were to turn this film into a show, how would I go about doing that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The climax is obviously the most exciting part, but the entire story is remarkably mellow and subdued. Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The backdrops for the stage would also need to be fairly simple. But we could make it so that they change little by little as the protagonist's feelings evolve over time...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Where the characters stand would also play a crucial role. They'd start out far apart, but move closer together as they get to know one another...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I really got ahead of myself there...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I just can't help but think about how to put on a good show.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In any case, I want to take what I can from this film and use it to learn how to put on better performances...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We won't be there for very long, but I'd like to make the most of this experience.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Seeing the film we helped make together was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That's all you've been saying for like the past hour.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because it was super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, while we watched, I was reminded of what we had for lunch each day and all the things we had to carry up that big hill...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everything we did all came rushing back☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I could almost smell the sea air when it got to the beach scene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We did make quite a lot of memories working on the film.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, we did.
It was really fun looking back while we watched.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
On the other hand...
I got a little anxious when I saw myself appear during that one scene.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I found exactly where I was☆
Girl C was right on that bench feeding the pigeons!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Naturally, I also checked to see how I did!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Only half of my back ended up making the final cut...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'm more than happy with how we all did!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe we got to be in this film... We should try to make the most of this incredible experience and use it to put on better performances.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Seeing the scene where we got to appear was significant...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I was even more moved when I saw our names during the credits...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And not just once. We got to see our names twice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: On top of the casting credits, you, me and Tsukasa got to be mentioned as production staff!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. And you got credited as “Assistant to Mr. Ohara”, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I did.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I didn't actually end up contributing much, but I was happy to be mentioned as such...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, you didn't contribute much?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, because how we ultimately shot the climax was based on Mr. Ohara's idea. Not mine...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems that I still have a lot to learn.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's not true! We know you did your best, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, you spent so much time trying to figure out how to make the film better.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I bet everyone knows how hard you worked!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I have to agree with Emu.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You never shied away from the problem at hand. You thought long and hard about what the answer to that question was, and Bakuno said he was grateful for your efforts.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's right. The fact that you were credited as the director's assistant is proof that they recognize you did a good job.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What she said! You were a really good assistant!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I really appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Getting to work on the film ended up being invaluable. It showed me just how deep the directing rabbit hole goes.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (There's so much that I've still yet to learn, but that excites me greatly.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm going to do everything possible in order to become the best director I can. I'm going to make the others feel proud.)
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Phew...
That should be it for the shops I planned on visiting today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I managed to get everything I needed for running maintenance, so I'll head home and...

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
Hey, check out that screen!
It's that movie everyone's been talking about! “Fight Spade”, right?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Yeah, and the action scenes are supposed to be really cool. I've sorta been meaning to go see it.

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Really?! Then, wanna go right now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ah, yes, it's the trailer for it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That movie has recently sort of become the talk of the town.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Movies...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That shoot we did ended up being an invaluable experience. Honestly, I still can't believe I got to work as an assistant to the director.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I was reminded of just how deep the directing rabbit hole goes since I got to learn about different techniques and about the director's thought process.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They said the action scenes for that film are supposed to be very good... I'm curious as to how they actually shot them.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So, I think I'll go see it now.
The next screening is...
A few hours later
Miyamasuzaka
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That film was much better than I expected.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It was written as your usual good-versus-evil hero spectacle...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But the stunts and fight scenes certainly lived up to their reputation.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They even shot some scenes from a first-person perspective. It was like the viewers got to be the hero as they chased after the villain.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That kind of trick makes it much easier to understand what a character is feeling.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But you can't really do that outside of the video medium. You need a camera to make that happen.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But is there a way to achieve the same sense of immersion during a show? How would I go about doing that?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Of course, it's likely going to involve the entire audience... What else would I need to—)
Hm? Rui? Is that you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, I thought it was you!
What a coincidence!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, what are the odds? So, Tsukasa, what brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My mom asked me to go get some ground beef from the supermarket!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Were you also out shopping, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I was buying some things I needed for maintenance. I also decided to go see a movie before heading home.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's called “Fight Spade”...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's the one Emu said she's been wanting to go see!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. She apparently saw the trailer the other day and kept exclaiming, “The space battle looked so cool! Everything went bang, zoom and sparkle-sparkle!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which made me interested too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The hero supposedly puts on an incredible performance during the action scenes, so I'd like to go see it and try learning what I can!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... I had no idea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I guess we've all been interested in films ever since we finished doing that shoot.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, I'll start telling you all about any new films that catch my eye.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, if any interest all four of us, we could go see them together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Together?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I think we stand to gain quite a lot since we'd get to discuss and analyze them as a group.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's an excellent idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I'll also let you all know about any films that catch my attention! No, we should all be doing this!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All of us...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! We should tell Nene and Emu about this idea! Where did I put my phone...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe. All of us, eh?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The old me would never have imagined any of this happening.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But now, I'm doing shows with my friends...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And even after leaving Phoenix Wonderland, we're still trying new things together.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I really can't ask for more...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In order to make my own dream come true, as well as to make them shine as brightly as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I need to keep improving as a director.)
Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I came to see what else SEKAI's new area had to offer...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But it's just so expansive. I've only visited a fraction of it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, there are many places that I'd like to see, so I'll keep exploring for now.
Hi, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Miku, Rin.
I didn't realize you two were also here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup☆ We're here to explore this area as members of the new expedition team♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
New expedition team...?
That sounds like quite a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know, right? We've been doing lots of exploring and talking to all sorts of plushies☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, would it be alright if I joined you two? I'm actually also here to do some exploring.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Of course☆
So, let's GO GO GO♪
Outside the inn

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, look!
A bunch of plushies are gathered over there☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, what a lively sight.
What do you think's going—

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line: Next, we have a new trick for all of you. Watch as we balance on these balls!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, the zombies?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Cool! They're doing another performance today☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The zombies told us how they were really happy that they got to do a show with us and make everyone else smile!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And they decided to keep the party going by doing lots of different performances☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is that so?

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line:
Alright... Up! We...!
Go!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Whoa☆
He's doing a handstand on top of that ball!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Cool...! I wanna try doing that too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. It could be fun to do it with them.
So...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why don't we all join in?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Alright! Next, I'm gonna do some juggling☆
Check out...this!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
Hey, she's a great juggler!
She's dancing around while... Whoa! She just threw a ball under her legs!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Next up is...Miku the Acrobat☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Here I go, everyone☆
Ready, steady...

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Wow! One, two, three... H-How many backflips is she gonna do?!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line: We're just getting started! We're about to do everyone's favorite trick next! Handstands on top of these balls!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
I wanna see you guys do more!
What do you have in store for us next?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you all for coming to watch. We actually have balloons for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Wow, this balloon...! It looks just like a rose!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I twisted it into a rose.
I'm glad to see that you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Cool! I didn't know you could turn a balloon into such a pretty rose!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: I want one! I want one too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. I'll make something for each of you.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yay! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe. We decided to join in partway through, but it's nice to see that our audience is having so much fun.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line: We're just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The zombies also seem to be enjoying themselves.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you for letting us join you guys☆
That was really fun♪

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
We also had a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: On top of that, fewer plushies feel scared of us since we started putting on these performances.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah, and we have you guys to thank for that. We wouldn't have been able to become friends with them otherwise.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Also, we should do another show together sometime!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Anyway, see you later.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe! It was so great to see the zombies and other plushies smiling and laughing together☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and I'm so glad to see that they've managed to become friends with everyone in this city.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! It's a good thing that you asked them to do that show♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, the zombies all seem to be having so much fun now☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, good thing we did.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I guess I really do want to bring people together...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Through shows that transcend borders.)
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's odd. Where did that breadboard go? I thought I left it somewhere around here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm...? I could've sworn this used to be on that shelf. And this was hanging from the ceiling...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... That film did keep me very busy recently. As a result, this place has turned into a bit of a sty...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
In any case, I should try to tidy up...
That should make it easier to find the breadboard.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now then...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (If it weren't so late at night, I'd move everything out of my room and back in one by one...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For now, I'll just move the things I need off to the left and whatever I don't to the right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Phew...
I've mostly divided everything up into a couple nice piles.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But despite all this cleaning and sorting, I still can't seem to find that breadboard...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Where did past me put it a few days ago?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? This box...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, how nostalgic...!
This is the dog robot I tried to make all those years ago!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If I recall, I wasn't happy with the way his legs and tail moved. My plan was to rebuild his joints from scratch...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I had trouble acquiring the parts I wanted, which ended with me putting everything on hold.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of joints...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The time has come for the bird robot I made for our shows to rise once more...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As Robo-Phoenix!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, it's up!
Time to catch you!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The joints I used for Robo-Phoenix's wings might just be what Robo-Dog's legs and tail need.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Alright, cleaning time's over.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Where did I put Robo-Phoenix's parts...?
I saw them just... Ah, here we are!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, also! If I want him to move like a real dog, I should make him look like one!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The right pile should have just what I need...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, this...!
I can put something I was going to throw out to good use! Two birds with one stone!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let's get started!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, how's that...?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Dog
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Excellent! Your legs are definitely moving much more smoothly compared to back then!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Dog
rows.Line: Woof! Woof!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, please try to keep your voice down.
It is half past three in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I guess I'll just have to mute you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He looks and walks much more like a real dog now.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But aside from walking and barking, all he's really able to do is stand around...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I should try to give him more of a doglike charm by getting him to behave more like a real one...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh...
*Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm getting very sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Fortunately, I have tomorrow...or rather, today...off.
I can get some sleep, wake up and take Robo-Dog to the park.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If I want to learn how to make him behave like a real dog, then I should go see some.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: *Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For now, I should go to sleep...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Good night...
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. You finally get to meet Tsukasa and the others.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you ready, Robo-Dog?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Dog
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, good. You're responding well to vocal input.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, Rui, we're here!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, welcome.
Please, come inside.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Alright, pardon us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Pardon us... Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...? Th-This room...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, why's all this stuff split into two different piles?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tell us, Rui! What's going on here?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, please try to ignore those.
I was in the middle of doing some cleaning.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This mess is from you cleaning...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Don't tell me...
You were trying to decide what to keep and what to throw out.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Correct! That's astounding, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all, the best way to clean your room is by removing anything you don't actually need!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're not wrong, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
More importantly, look!
Today, I'd like for you all to meet Robo-Dog!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Dog
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, he's adorable...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hello, Robo-Dog♪

rows.Speaker: Robo-Dog
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, he sat down! And he's wagging his tail!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa! Not only does he look like a real dog, he even moves and behaves like one!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Good, right?
I've been going to the park recently to research how real dogs move and behave!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, did you upgrade that robot you made a really long time ago...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You remembered?
Yes, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I just happened to come across him while cleaning my room.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, I thought the joints I used for Robo-Phoenix would allow Robo-Dog to move a little smoother!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I ended up staying up very late working on him.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And that's why you stopped cleaning partway through...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Dog
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, look! He's scratching his head with his hind leg!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, like a real dog.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But he only seems to be able to bark in a couple different ways...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've also been working on that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I want voice clips that are imbued with emotion, but there's only so much freeware available to me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, would you all mind if I took some samples of your voices?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, do you mean you want us to bark like dogs...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He doesn't “want” us to. He expects us to...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it's written all over his face.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yip! Yip, yip! Yip!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She's gone straight into the deep end...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it's impressive how you can just tell she's inviting us to join her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, Emu, that's excellent!
You're oozing with animal spirit!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now, Tsukasa, Nene, if you would.
I'm sure this will help when you need to play dogs in future performances!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's never going to happen! No, I can't say that with any certainty... If anything, there's probably a strong likelihood that I will!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, true.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I'll just have to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Boof! Boof, boof!
No, that sounds too deep for Robo-Dog...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right.
Small dogs are a little more high pitch...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Woof! Woof! Woof!
*Whimper*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, that was...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene, your dog impression's really cute!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well done, Nene!
Alright, let me try that again...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Woof! Pant...! Pant...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, it wouldn't be fair for me to do nothing. Let me also give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
*Whimper*
Arf... Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't think dogs are supposed to be so in-your-face...
Mikazukigumi Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Unsheathe your katana here and attack.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Turn around, look at the person behind you and parry their attack.)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: Good. Your movements look much sharper!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
But your katana looked light...
It didn't seem to weigh anything, you know?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It looked light...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I see... As Kurama Tengu, I thought I was supposed to be as light as possible on my feet as I moved around, but...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Fleet footwork isn't all he has.
He also possesses monstrous strength, which allows him to swing around a heavy sword with ease.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd forgotten that he isn't actually human. I failed to capture that part of him just now.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, that's exactly what I wanted to say!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, a bamboo sword weighs but a fraction of a real one. I can act all I want, but I'm not sure I'll be able to make it look heavy...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, how do I go about this problem...?)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Kamishiro...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
I was just wondering how I'm going to make my katana feel heavy.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
Right...
I guess the best solution is to hold a real one.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A real one...
But actually finding one sounds a bit difficult.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: I happen to know someone at a shop that sells swords. Want me to ask them? They might be willing to help you out.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Really? Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
Alright, I'll try asking them.
Should I tell them that all four of you are going?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that would be incredibly helpful.
And thank you for going out of your way to do this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I can't believe they're willing to do so much for us.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still, if I'm learning about katanas, I don't want to stop at just holding one...)
A few days later
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Seeing all those real katanas with Tsukasa and the others was such a wonderful learning experience.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We got to try holding all types, large and small. They even let us equip some in order to see how heavy they felt at our waist.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And I really wasn't expecting them to show us the tang underneath where the handle would go.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Anyway...
I was able to get the lumber I wanted at the store...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, let's start making that practice sword.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(I got to see quite a lot today.
And making my own sword should help deepen my understanding of the subject.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's unfortunate that I can't make a real one here since that would be the best solution...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But making a wooden one should help further solidify what I saw today in my mind.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not to mention this is my very first time crafting one from scratch. This is all very exciting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, which part should I work on first?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Why don't I begin with the blade?
That should be the easiest place to start.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'll mark where I need to cut with my pen and saw accordingly...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Next, the tip... I'll need to carefully shave a round corner off the edge here.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Phew...
It's beginning to look like a real katana now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The surface is still a little rough, but I can deal with that later by sanding it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still, it feels much thicker than the ones we saw today. I think I'll make it thinner and...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, it feels about as thin as a real one. But it appears it would be weak to strikes from the side...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which means I won't want to parry attacks the same way I did during practice the other day.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Also, where I place this katana's center of gravity will likely change how I'm able to wield it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The closer it is to my hand, the easier it will be to swing around, but at the cost of power. On the other hand, the closer it is to the tip, the heavier it'll seem.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still, Kurama Tengu would probably have no problem swinging around such a weapon...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm glad I'm doing this. I'm learning so much.)
A few days later

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Mikazukigumi Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Unsheathe, then...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Turn around. You'll see one of the Taira henchmen trying to take a chop at you and...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Parry while also trying to dodge!
Taking that attack head-on would mean damaging your katana.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This katana's center of gravity sits at the tip, so it wobbling this much is normal when parrying an attack...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(But I'm Kurama Tengu.
I should be able to swing a blade like this as easily as breathing.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Step, flex your wrist muscles and slice!)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
That was awesome, Kamishiro...!
The way you moved just now was so realistic.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: Yeah! I guess you've gotten a better understanding of how Kurama Tengu's supposed to fight.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
Still, I can't believe it.
You've improved so much in such a short amount of time.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: Did you guys actually go check out some real katanas at that shop we talked about the other day?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we did. That ended up being an invaluable experience for us. Thank you for introducing us to them.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
No, don't worry about that.
All I did was make one phone call.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
