rows.Line: In any case, this scene's gonna feel so different now. Is this all really because of that one visit?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, not quite... Actually holding real katanas did help, but I also ended up making a wooden one for practice afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: A wooden one?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I thought actually making one myself would help me achieve a better understanding of swords as opposed to just seeing and feeling some.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And it helped quite a lot. Now I know that the broadside of a katana is very brittle, as well as how they were designed to cut while being unsheathed.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
Wow, that's how you learned?
It's a unique approach, but I kinda like it.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: It's great that you have your own methodology! I think we're all looking forward to how the final product turns out.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (My own methodology, eh...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The thought of making my own katana just sort of popped into my head, but I'm glad that I was able to apply everything that I've learned until now.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And I should use this momentum I've built up to become a better swordfighter.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I still have a number of ideas as to how I can wield a katana more like Kurama Tengu.)
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, thank you for having me here today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll be stealing what I can from your personal training regimen, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, you surprised me when you sent me that message saying, “I'd like to join you during your next holiday training session.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I apologize for asking on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But our Mikazukigumi training has left me believing that my muscles leave much to be desired.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm the director of our troupe, but also an actor. I feel that I need to train more in order to put on good performances.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
That's very admirable of you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, my training regimen involves some of the things Mr. Kijima suggested, so it's far from a walk in the park...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Please feel free to stop and take a break if it starts being too much for you! I'd rather you didn't push yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I understand.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The strength exercises Tsukasa does on a regular basis are hard to begin with.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, getting through all of these isn't going to be easy. I'll need to muster up all the courage I can here...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, let's begin!
With some stretches before we actually start!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
First, our shoulders!
Stretch out both your arms and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Next, shuttle runs!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Remember the things Mr. Kijima talked about! Breathe to match the pace at which you run and mind what your body does when you change directions!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Right...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This is a good exercise in terms of understanding the way your body moves, since your speed's changing constantly.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ready? Start!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Next, we have planking while reading lines. This isn't going to be easy...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Drop your katana and leave this place!
Only then shall I spare your life!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
*Wince*
“Oh, have you...no manners...?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(No...!
My abs... It's so hard to speak...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I have to do what Emu and Mr. Kijima did. Ushiwakamaru needs to sound more relaxed. Doing this was my choice, so try to hang in there...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Put away...that dreadful thing and...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This is what Tsukasa does on a regular basis. I thought I'd been doing enough on my own, but I clearly haven't.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Looks like you can't move a muscle.
Here, I got you something to drink.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I can't believe you can still move after doing all those exercises...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I am a future star, after all!
I need to be able to handle this much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But credit where credit's due, Rui, I'm amazed you made it through until the end!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I would've been ashamed to give up after asking for your help.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And you ended up pushing yourself to the limit...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: More importantly, what did you think after giving my training regimen a try? Did you find anything that might help?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd have to reduce the number of reps I do, as well as learn how to use my body better, but I'm strongly considering incorporating some of the exercises we just did into my own workouts.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Especially reading lines while planking...
As hard as that was, I believe it'll do wonders for me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Is that so...?
Still, Rui, you really shouldn't push yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you.
I promise not to, since the last thing I want is to get hurt.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But in order to become a good director, I want to learn as much as I possibly can during our time with Mikazukigumi.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I plan on being able to complete any exercise that's thrown at me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I admire your voracity!
I wouldn't expect any less from our troupe's director!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's both make the most of the time we have left with Mikazukigumi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
The day before Rui's birthday
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's been some time since we last had such fine weather. It's the perfect day to test my stage equipment.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hahaha! You're so giddy, Rui☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm positively filled with joy, Emu. After all, you've all agreed to help me test these new devices.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When we asked if there was anything you wanted to do for your birthday, I wasn't expecting this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gah, to think he would ask for our help at the moment we couldn't refuse...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I wonder what kinda gizmos he's got this time!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We're gonna lay low and see all the action☆ I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're all designed to put a smile on every face, so I hope you'll maintain those high expectations.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Actually, I'm really worried about this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have no reservations helping you develop new special effects... But absolutely nothing that explodes, you hear me?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, do you think I would bring explosives to a public space like this...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought I had your full trust, but that's how you all see me...? This sorrow is going to tear my heart to pieces...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ever heard of something called a “track record”?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In a way, it's my trust in you that's motivating me to warn you like this. I've seen you cause panic with your explosives enough times to “trust” that you'll do it again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No need to worry. I'm perfectly aware of this park's rules. Rest assured that safety will be a priority as I conduct these tests.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I hope that's true...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hahaha...>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh, ooh, Rui! What does this one do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, did that one pique your interest, Emu? I suppose that can be the first we test.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Based on how it looks, I suppose it's a drone.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But is it different from your usual ones?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, actually. You see, I've equipped it with some features that will help create stage effects.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Like... This one, for example.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wah, it's so bright! And all sparkly and shiny!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, it has lights mounted on it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And with multiple such drones, I could light the stage from all different angles.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That would open up new avenues of artistic expression, even at outdoor venues where infrastructure may be limited.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <That sounds pretty useful!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wow, does it have any other fun features?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. Besides that one... Ah, how about this?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa, it's shooting out flower petals...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooow! It's raining petals!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I improved upon my last petal-emitting device and tried attaching it here. Besides flower petals, I can also make it spray confetti or smoke.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With a drone, it's possible to bring these effects out to the audience. These will allow me to create a great level of immersion.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, it sounds like this device opens up some interesting possibilities! This is the sort of thing I want to see!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I couldn't be happier to hear that you've taken a liking to it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, I have a suspicion that this one will strike your fancy as well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What does that one do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This shoots out bolts of lightning.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hold your horses! That's nothing like flower petals or confetti!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You think so? I consider them to be fairly similar.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
They are not!
What's more, anything that shoots out electricity cannot be allowed at a public park!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why did you even make that? It sounds like a weapon.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was thinking that the chance to see film-level special effects on stage would please everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ahh, to see lightning bolts fly across our stage...! Flashes of light hailing down in a storm...! This would allow us to manifest the true majesty of an intergalactic battle!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa! That'd be sooo cool!
I bet it'd be super impressive at night!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't go starting a real intergalactic battle on stage!
What are you guys doing...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm?
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: I thought I recognized some voices over here...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Kamishiro, Tenma, it really is you two.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, Miyake, Taniyama, Hayashi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, what a coincidence that we'd meet here!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Are you testing some new invention out here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, we're here granting Rui's birthday wish by helping with his tests!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My actual birthday is tomorrow, but today was preferable since we don't have school.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: I see... No, wait! Kamishiro, it's your birthday tomorrow?!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Wow, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you.
I never guessed that I'd get to hear your warm wishes a day early.

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Tomorrow's the day, huh. Should we have lunch together then?

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds great! We'll treat you to whatever you want!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How kind of you. I'm looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Great! Okay, we've got plans after this, so we'll be on our way!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: See you tomorrow.
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To think you'd get to make plans for your birthday here and now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, certainly a surprise. I'm quite excited for tomorrow.
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright! Everything's ready☆
Everybody, let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
<Happy birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting you to have prepared something like this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, it would have been a waste to let the day end having only tested some equipment!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We had to throw a birthday picnic to celebrate!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't think I've ever heard of a birthday picnic, but I guess this kind of thing can be nice once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, this kind of fresh spin is quite refreshing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <The lunches you brought look amazing.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah, totally! I hope we get to try some!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There's lots left over that we couldn't fit in these lunch boxes, so we'll bring some over to SEKAI later!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, are all this food and the cake homemade?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course!
We specially cooked and boxed up these lunches first thing this morning!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And me and Nene worked super hard on your cake! I hope it came out yummy☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. With how delicious it looks, I'm sure you have nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And most impactful of all... Between the fried chicken, Salisbury steak and croquettes, all these beautiful shades of brown are stirring up my appetite.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We actually wanted to make it a bit more colorful, but this is how things turned out when we put in all the stuff you like...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: None of us could think of anything green you might enjoy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, this is the perfect form of a boxed lunch, I assure you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That being said, this looks to be a lot of food for just four people.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I guess the four of us won't be able to finish it all.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh! Someone's coming this way!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh no! We've gotta hide!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, over there... Is that Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, it's Tenma and his troupe!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, hello all of you. What good chums you are, to be spending your day off together!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha, it was a total coincidence though! I only bumped into Li'l Bro and the gang a minute ago.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It just kinda happened while we were on our way back from practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you all out for a picnic?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You could say that. My friends here put this together to celebrate my birthday.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh right, 'cause your birthday's tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A birthday picnic sounds so fun, especially in this nice weather.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh... I've got it! Hey, guys! Why don't you celebrate with us?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: As you can probably see, we made way too much food...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, since I'm here, I guess I'll crash this party♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We don't have any plans right now either, so what do you say we all join in?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess we can...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, once again...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!!!
Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: These are...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, flower petals are raining from the sky!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Falling from that drone flying around, you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It would seem you've already mastered my new contraption, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The perfect thing was sitting right there, so it would've been wrong not to use it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! While we're at it, let's shine a spotlight on Rui for the rest of the day!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I'll pass on that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Go on! Rest assured, there's plenty to drink too! Please, savor the dishes we've made!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you. I'll do just that...
Yes, these omelets are seasoned just the way I like them. They're quite delicious.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ooh! You really mean it?
I made those, actually! Yippee!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Time to dig in♪
Whoa, this fried chicken is great! Who made this?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, I-I did...
Um, I'm glad it came out well...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, this Salisbury steak's not bad either.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
A discerning eye as always!
You've chosen my specialty, Shining Pegasus Salisbury Steak!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I dunno where the pegasus comes in... But it's good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But wow, isn't it crazy how we ran into Kamishiro right when we were talking about him?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? About me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. We were discussing what to do for your birthday tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Like, how a surprise could be good since you're not really the type to make a big deal of your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, and how you'd probably be floored if we brought you some cake during the lunch break!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm touched that you were all making such plans for my sake. That being said, are you sure you wanted to tell me about it?

rows.Speaker: An, Toya & Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah. The atmosphere of the picnic put us too at ease...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well hey, just think of it like this: you've got one more thing to look forward to! Let's come up with a new surprise plan later, guys!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, I'll be taking part!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Set your expectations high for tomorrow, Rui♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be looking forward to seeing what mise-en-scène you all come up with for the day.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An, Akito & Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for letting us join your picnic! It was really fun getting to celebrate together!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess it wasn't a bad way to celebrate. When you do something at school, you've gotta make it fit in the little bit of time between classes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Indeed.
Still, I'm always amazed at the ideas Tsukasa and the others come up with. Kamishiro had such a happy look on his face.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He was a little different from how he is at school. He even did another demonstration of his stage equipment for us! That was so fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha, the one that shot out electricity was a different story though...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, I was glad to see you so happy, Rui. I hope you have another fun year ahead!

rows.Speaker: Honami & Minori
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kohane told us about your birthday picnic. That's such a wonderful way to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sitting around, eating some food... I bet that was super relaxing! I wanna take Samo out for a picnic sometime!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that case, I'd love to bring Shibao and have one together. What do you say, Kamishiro? Would you like to attend with Robo-Dog?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, that'd be fun!

rows.Line: Your heart keeps on filling up with happy memories with your friends and teammates.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Rui
rows.Line: It feels like there isn't any space for us, anymore...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's true that I don't feel nearly as alone as I used to, thanks to Tsukasa and the others.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I've never wanted to forget those days, nor do I think I should.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's true that those days left marks that will never fade...
But it's because of them that I know now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ...Just how much of a miracle Wonderlands×Showtime is.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was because of those lonely, painful days that I was able to take that step forward.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I didn't want to make the choice that would split us apart.
Even if it would put us on the shortest roads to each of our dreams.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It drove me to search furiously for a way for the four of us to carry onward together. To cling to that miracle we had found.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At the very least, I don't believe there's such a thing as a memory one is better off without.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Knowing suffering can make one kinder. Knowing sadness helps you treasure the warmth of a smile.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's exactly the same.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Knowing loneliness has shown me the value of companionship...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And that Wonderlands×Showtime is my most priceless treasure in the world.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Rui
rows.Line: Treasure...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You don't have to go anywhere.
You will always have a place here.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Rui
rows.Line: So... We can stay there?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Rui
rows.Line: Because I found a very special treasure.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mm...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Maybe the fragment of a feeling, the little Rui, is a part of you again now♪

rows.Line: I see...

rows.Line:

We found them!

rows.Line: What happened? Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:

There was no problem at all.

rows.Speaker: Rui

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've never been this excited in my life!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is arguably the best place to learn about musicals, so we'll need to make the most of our time here.

rows.Line: I'm a little worried about Nene and Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right. We haven't been separated like this before now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I don't think we need to worry about them.

rows.Line: Hm? What makes you say that?

rows.Line: Nene and Emu have both overcome quite a lot in order to get to this point.

rows.Speaker: Rui

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If anything, they may grow quite a bit while they're away from us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:

rows.Line: Yes, let's improve so much that even they won't believe it.

rows.Line: (Place one leg on the barre and tilt your upper body forwards, backwards and side to side. This is an exercise called “limbering”, intended to make your groin more flexible.)

rows.Line: Of course...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: *Wince*

rows.Line: However, we seem to be doing okay in terms of stamina.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Ah, that's unfortunate...

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes... Unfortunately...

rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Line: <But based on the way they were behaving, something is definitely bothering them...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<What do we do...?

rows.Line: I'm just about to have a meeting to discuss the direction and effects...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <A magician?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Ah!>

rows.Line: My apoloGIES. Did I keep you waitING?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not at all. I was absorbed in my work.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: WonderFUL. Let's begin our meetING.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: First, I suppose we should go over the basic story.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be portraying two rival musical groups, who come to understand and accept one another through their performances.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: YeS, I will play the role of the MagiCIAN, from STELLA. And you will be the InvenTOR, from WORLDS.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. The two characters are rivals, and compete both in effects and in song.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: HaHA, these roles certainly are perfect for uS♪

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: So as I see iT, until the midPOINT, we will be free to design performances as we each see fiT.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: YoU, using your robots and dronES, and mE, with my “maGIC.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. The key, of course, is the final performance, put on jointly between the two groups after they've accepted one another.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In order to highlight how the groups have come together, I would like the final performance to include effects both “invented” and “magical.”

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: I couldn't agree morE. This collaboration is a rare opportuniTY, so I would like to create something new working with yoU.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: HmM... How about thiS? As a special treaT, I'll show you some of the tricks behind Switch's stage efFECTS.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You would reveal the secrets of your magic?

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line:
YeS. Of coursE, magic is effective specifically because it's a seCRET...
But if I keep all my cards close to my chesT, how will we be able to work togethER?

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: As you knoW, Rui, we use magic to astound and delight our audiENCE.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: Our “magic” comes in many forMS: lighTS, screeNS, and so oN. This timE, I would like to use a chemical reactant I developed mySELF.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: I'll give you a special demonstraTION, so watch closeLY.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <He put a bunch of colored liquids in a bottle and is swirling them around.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yeah. What do you think is going to happen...?>

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: TherE... All readY.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: Abracadabra, chichin pui pui...♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wow! The smoke coming from the bottle is sparkling and shining!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It truly is a magical sight.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: WhY, thank you very mucH.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: In any casE, this is only one small example of the possibilities when using chemical reactions to produce maGIC.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: So I wonDER, what kind of scientific breakthroughs could our genius Inventor create with this maGIC?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, indeed... Perhaps...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What if we caused it to explode?

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: ExPLODE?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We can load those reactants into air cannons modified to increase force, and deliver them like a firework payload.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After a powerful shockwave, magic rains from the sky. Wouldn't that be an enthralling effect?

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: AhaHA... They do say art is an exploSION. You certainly are as unorthodox as the rumors sugGEST...

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line:
But I think it's a fine ideA.
This will be a spectacular spelL♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Hmm... While we're at it, why not add in some lights and...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I don't know what it is, but Rui seems so... Energetic!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha, he does.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Rui probably hasn't had many chances to talk to other directors close to him in age...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Maybe he's happy to have made a director friend.)

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line:
YeS, that's a fine plaN.
NoW, how will we realize iT?

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line:
Could you show me the blueprints for the air canNON?
I'll also need your data on its range and other specificaTIONS.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. I'll send you the files now.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: I seE... YeS, with these specS, there should be no problem implementing the chemical reacTION. I'll perform a practical test straightaWAY.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sakasaki. Would you allow me to assist you with this test?

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: Of coursE. As thanks for sharing the bluePRINTS, I don't mind tipping my hand just a little morE.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Haha, that wasn't my intention.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: There's no need to maintain appearANCES. I myself am happy to have such a capable assistant by my sidE.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: NoW, let the magic class beGIN♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wow! Magic class, he said!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Ah, Len! Don't lean out too far...!>

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: HmM? Did I just see something movE...?

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: Perhaps it was just my imaginaTION?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We don't want to distract them, so we should head back now.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It sure looks like their show is going to be amazing.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! Hehehe, I'm looking forward to tomorrow already!>

ASTRO FES Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Good. Rehearsals are proceeding smoothly. Everyone is working so well together, you wouldn't think we only just began yesterday.)

rows.Line: Sakasaki.

rows.Line:

Everything's all set herE. Just say the worD.

rows.Speaker: Akito

rows.Speaker: Akito & Jun
rows.Line: ーー♪ ーー♪

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: I'm surE. But all that means is that you were successfully enchantED.

rows.Line: So, what's wrong with it then?

rows.Line: It was only a minor variation, but the air cannon didn't get the range we wanted.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: UnacceptaBLE.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: Our goal here is to bring happiness to every person who's come to see uS. That is Switch's duTY— The duty of a magiCIAN.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sakasaki...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're right. I want this show to bring smiles and happiness to all of our guests. Anything less is unacceptable.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: HaHA, I knew you would aGREE.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: Innovation always walks hand in hand with failURE. Let us learn from this mistake and use it to perfect our maGIC.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Well, that sure sounds nice. But are you going to have time to do that?

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: No need to worRY. We have a genius Inventor and a genius Magician herE, after alL.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: When we work togethER, there's nothing we can't dO. RighT, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, certainly.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That said... Adjusting the air cannon's specs directly would be difficult. And there's no guarantee a smaller reactant payload would work, either.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Line: What if we incorporated drones?

rows.Speaker: Akito

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: I seE. That way the magic will reach everyONE. Do you have the drones' bluePRINTS?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can send you the data shortly... But I'll be equipping them with aerosol-type spray nozzles.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: I'll need to adjust the reactant mixture someWHAT, theN.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: Rui, I'll need you to prepare the following for mE.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Astounding... They're in perfect sync.

rows.Speaker: Toya

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
This page in the book.
After you say, “The first stop along his journey was a chilly land of snow and ice.” How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think you'll want to set the stage early for an adventure through a winter wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Nene

rows.Line: Yes, I was also thinking that it'd be best to divide up the work. So, I've come up with a timeline of who is going to be doing what.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...!

rows.Speaker: Rui

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Rui

rows.Speaker: Rui

rows.Line: I hate to make you wait like this, but I promise to finish my adjustments in time for the event.

rows.Speaker: Honami

rows.Line: You can't do too much or too little. If you don't strike the right balance, you end up hurting instead of helping them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why it's a director's job to obsess over these sorts of things. It's also why directing is so fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I plan on doing everything I can to ensure the elementary schoolers who attend the event have a fantastic time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Rui

rows.Line: I am better than him!

rows.Line: What...?

rows.Line: U-Uhh... Robo-Nene?

rows.Line: Is she trying to show up Robo-Dog?

rows.Line: Oh... Hold on...

rows.Line: Does this mean she's jealous of him...?

rows.Line:
I look away for one moment, and you've tossed all this on my plate...!
Keep your vegetables to yourself!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, aren't you observant.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seriously, what are you doing...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, Tsukasa, you've got so many veggies on your plate now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Honestly, isn't it high time that you overcame your dislike of vegetables?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What? Why do you say that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, don't give me that look! You'll have to sooner or later!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I believe we've already been over this.
I don't have to eat vegetables to get the nutrients I need.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I mean, isn't my height proof enough?
Therefore, I don't need to eat them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I knew you'd say that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, what if you're put in a situation where you have no choice but to eat them?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For example, there's a chance that we'll perform in a region which built its name on producing quality vegetables. Would you be able to turn down any samples?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, that is actually a distinct possibility.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Imagine telling them that you really hate vegetables. I don't even wanna think about how sad you'd make them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Obviously, I don't plan on making them feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I'll overcome that situation using the perfect plan.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The perfect plan...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've actually come up with multiple ways to turn such people down depending on the situation.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When we're brought gifts to our green room, when we're visiting somewhere and a local suddenly appears with produce, or when we're invited to a dinner party...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's no telling when vegetables are going to appear in my life next, so I've come up with plans for every situation I can imagine.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'm prepared for any that are thrown at me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why can't you just use that energy to overcome your dislike of them instead...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, do you also have a plan for if you're cast in a role that involves eating veggies?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A role that involves eating vegetables?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I mean, there's no telling what kind of show we're gonna do next, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, I glossed over that possibility.
I was under the impression that I'd never have to play such a role.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the likelihood of me accepting a request of that nature isn't zero, provided I was convinced that I was the only one for the role.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means I'll need to start learning how to make vegetables disappear by pretending to eat them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! Like a magic trick!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not “like”. That is a magic trick.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seriously, you always come up with the most roundabout solutions when it comes to vegetables...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It'll probably be a while before you overcome this dislike...
Aboard a Train

rows.Speaker: Female Passenger A
rows.Line:
Kikyogumi's show was so good!
And I really liked their new members!

rows.Speaker: Female Passenger B
rows.Line: Now that we can get tickets at a more reasonable price, I might go to their next show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everybody seems to like the new Kikyogumi quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was worried that it would take the students a long time to meld with the others and master the story...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But they managed to put together a spectacular performance in such a short period of time. It was a good reminder of the power Morinomiya possesses.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and based on the incredible show they just put on, I believe they have a bright future ahead of them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Suzu's also been hearing about how everyone's really enjoying this new format, which has been putting a big smile on her face!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I checked social media to see what everyone's saying about today's show. People are posting positive comments for the most part.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's see... Ah, look at that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Even existing Kikyogumi fans seem to understand the charm and value of this change.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. A lot of people seemed pretty apprehensive about the idea of students performing on that stage...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it looks like that went away after actually seeing them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, check it out!
A bunch of them aren't just relieved, they're amazed!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm glad all the hard work those boys put in paid off!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. They may be students, but they really are remarkable actors.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Look here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<The actor I really like is still a student?!
He was so amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Those boys brought such a fresh charm to the stage. I really want to root for them now! I can't wait to see how they grow as actors moving forward!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! That's great! They already have fans!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It would seem the opportunity to cheer for them presents its own charm, different from that of supporting established actors.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all, fans can enjoy seeing their favorite actors grow and improve.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I hope things continue to go well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too! And this is Morinomiya we're talking about, so I'm sure they'll do just fine!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, in terms of watching actors grow, we experienced something similar at the Wonder Stage...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: At the Wonder Stage?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We had quite a lot of people cheering for us, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It is always nice to see regulars in the crowd when you're on stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And it's so easy to pick them out☆
I remember waving whenever I saw them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We also saw a steady increase in the size of the audience with each show we did.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I still vividly remember the sea of people we saw during our final show at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And they all wished us well when it came time to say goodbye to the stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have a feeling that they were also looking forward to seeing how we'd grow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, you might be right...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope we get a chance to show them just how much we've grown someday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If we're going to do that, then we'll need to keep finding ways to improve!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right. Let's do our best to surpass their expectations, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Emu, Tsukasa & Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yeah...!
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa and the others don't appear to be here yet...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I think I'll look through that pamphlet I just bought while I wait for them.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The latest film by one of the giants of science fiction, and it's become the talk of the town.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only were all the spaceships designed beautifully, the graphics used for the planets were just stellar.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (What would I need to do in order to create that sensation of being in outer space on the stage?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Projection mapping is one idea, but that would make everything look two-dimensional. So...)
Rui... Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It'd be best to bring things out to the audience. If I employ some drones, I could...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Earth to Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, you're all here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You finally noticed!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You were mumbling something to yourself just now. Were you coming up with new effect ideas...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. The film I saw before coming here has helped me come up with quite a few.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah! What did you see?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was a science fiction film released the other day. It takes place in outer space, and is quite a fun adventure.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I decided to go see it after hearing how stunning the graphics are.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I might be interested in seeing that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too☆
Also, Rui, what kinds of ideas did you come up with?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was thinking of ways to take the computer-generated universe I saw and recreate it on stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The sensation of traveling through a sea of stars, and watching stellar bodies as they fly right in front of you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It'd make for such a fun and stunning experience for the audience, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The feeling of outer space in a theatre!
How grand that would be...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It does sound pretty cool, but wouldn't it be hard to pull off?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I'm wondering if I could use drones to act as stars and such...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which would mean somehow miniaturizing them, while also greatly reducing the noise they produce.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But getting that to work would open up avenues to all sorts of other ideas.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh, like what?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For example, how about a sword fight...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We could use drones to illustrate sword swings, afterimages and sparks as they parry. Wouldn't that be a sight to behold?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, that'd be incredibly dramatic...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They could even be used during scenes that involve singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In order to make a dance look more dazzling, the drones could fill the theatre with bursts of light.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And dim drone lights in an otherwise dark theatre would create more of a mystical feel when people are singing. Those are just a few possibilities...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We get to dance with magic lights...?!
That sounds super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and I'm curious what it'd be like to sing in that sort of setup.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and it should also be a new experience for the audience.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You always seem to have so much fun when we have these sorts of discussions, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Truth be told, there is nothing else that I find more enjoyable.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not just because it's fun to come up with ideas for shows, but also because I have friends who will help make them happen.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Trusted actors who always seem to go well beyond my wildest expectations.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All reasons why I can't seem to stop coming up with ideas.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've been inspired by quite a few other things, so I hope you're all looking forward to testing out my new ideas.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We should expect nothing less of our valiant director.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to see what you come up with☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Incidentally...
I've just come up with another idea.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Just now?
Does it involve those drones?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. For instance, they could be used during scenes that involve explosions.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The audience would be able to enjoy a wonderfully compelling effect that's also perfectly safe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Stop right there!
Enjoying yourself is great and all, but leave explosions out of it!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Ah, here it is. “The Traveling Troupe”...
It's been quite a while since I last read this script.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We did this show not too long ago, but it feels nostalgic nonetheless...)
Ah, there you are.
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, what are you all doing here?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Miku and the others said you were here in SEKAI, so we were wondering where.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was looking for this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's... The script for “The Traveling Troupe”?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Remember how we ended up performing it in that dream?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That seems to have made me want to read it again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
I understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That show does mean a lot to us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I know it was just a dream, but getting to put it on together made me so happy!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me as well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Come to think of it, this show's been involved in our troupe's most critical moments.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was where everything began for our troupe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Without this show, Wonderlands×Showtime would probably never have existed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. It was also the show we used to say goodbye to the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. The Wonder Stage was so sparkly and full of smiles when we did this show that time...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. That's a really nice memory...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: During that dream...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe this show helped us remember what matters most to us, including all of our memories of the past.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What matters most to us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. For example, the moments we were able to grow because we were all together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And just how precious the time we get to spend together as Wonderlands×Showtime really is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The time we get to spend together... Yeah, I think it was this show that reminded me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that sense, this show has a very special place in our hearts.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why you mentioned how this show has been involved in our troupe's most critical moments...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. So, the next time we do this show, we may find ourselves at another crossroads.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When do you think that's gonna be...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, all I can say for certain is that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The next time we perform “The Traveling Troupe”, we'll need to put on our best rendition of it yet!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just another reason for us to keep growing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're focused on the quality of the performance?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I agree with him. The next time we perform it, I want it to be even more fun and exciting!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'm not about to let my past self defeat me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Since I am the director of Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (What sorts of shows are we going to be able to do as we travel and grow as a troupe?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Just the thought is making my heart dance.)
Days before Rui's birthday
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And that concludes our Happy Birthday Special Show!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. It was wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hooray! Rui's smiling so bright☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you enjoyed it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was a story full of warmth and kindness.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The protagonist faced many trials, but received help from many different people on his way to his birthday party...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And it was a wholly new show, as well. Was it you who wrote the script, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed it was. Miku and the others asked for my help with their celebratory show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And no celebration is complete without a party! Thus, I made reaching the party the goal of this little adventure.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Incidentally, I chose the songs, and Emu did all the choreography.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It was so much fun thinking up all sorts of celebration dances!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I did think the choreography seemed packed full of excitement. Now I see why.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How wonderful to celebrate my birthday with a show all of you worked on. I truly am happy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we're glad to hear that. But that's not all we have for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We may not be able to celebrate on the actual day of, but we'll make up for that today!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Tsukasa and Nene, you have school stuff to do that day, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's right, his hall monitor meeting and my committee work are probably going to run late. And Emu has a family thing that day...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's a little sad we can't all celebrate together on your real birthday...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we'll have lots of fun today! And send you lots and lots of birthday messages later, too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll look forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That said, I feel as though I've already received more than my fair share of celebration.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, now. The party's only just begun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's right. It's a little early to call it quits just yet.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, shall we move on to our next celebratory activity?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Next up is a stage magic show! Emu, Miku, take it away.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You bet! It's time for Miku and Emu's Marvelous Magic Show! Tsukasa and Nene, we'll have you help us too☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-da! Behold, a perfectly ordinary box. But what comes out of it is extraordinary!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Starting with these, to cast a magic spell of happiness on this party! Alakazam!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Chocolate and cookies... Just look at all those snacks.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that on its own doesn't feel especially party-like, does it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well then, how about this? Our next item is sure to excite☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alakazam♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, look at that. Party hats for everyone.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And fun sunglasses, too! The frames are shaped like birthday candles.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's feeling really party-ish now! But could it be even more party-ish?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wouldn't some fun games be just right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You know, like that game I've been wanting to play with everyone for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Good call, Nene! Your wish is my command! Aaand... Alakazam!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is this...a board game?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This game's really popular for its strategy and social deduction elements, too. I'd really like to play it with you all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then allow me to make a request, as well!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Fun times require fun music! Let's have some tunes to liven up the mood!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You got it! Here comes the fun music♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Nene
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Castanets and a triangle...and tambourines? What is all this?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Have fun making the music, Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You want me to play it myself?! At least give me something that can carry a melody!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oops, looks like we didn't get it right. I'll just try again... Alakazam!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, music is playing on stage. I see you put thought into staging. I'm impressed.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Snacks, party hats, games, music... I think that's just about everything you need for a party.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It ought to be a very fun party for sure.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, hold it right there. We're still missing something vital.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It just doesn't feel like a birthday party without it, does it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, right! There was one more thing!
Okay, Miku! Let's cast one more magic spell!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Right! Here goes!
Alakazam!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is this a cake?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All these white, yellow and pink dots along the top... Could they be soda candy?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ding ding ding♪ You got it, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's a custom-made soda candy ice cream cake, topped with your favorite candy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe. We helped with the toppings♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We worked hard to make it extra pretty.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you. I'm very happy with it.
I can't wait to give it a taste.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh, that's the biggest Rui smile we've seen today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! It seems this magic show was a roaring success!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's everything we need for the party. Let's have a great day today, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I can hardly contain myself already.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They planned this party for me, got these things together, and even made a cake...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I would be satisfied enough with this, but it seems the fun will continue.)
Rui's Birthday
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hm. No issues with the movement, and the responsiveness is acceptable.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That about wraps up maintenance on my drones.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, another one from Emu?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Because we couldn't celebrate on my actual birthday, she's been sending me a message every hour like clockwork.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It was a little surprising at first, but this kind of celebration is nice too.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa and Nene also stopped by to give me their well-wishes. How kind of them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now then, with my maintenance done, I should head home—
Oh, good! You're here today!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki. I didn't realize you were at school today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it was getting to the point I had to show up eventually...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, I'm glad I came in today, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just remembered earlier—it's your birthday, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So I was like, “I wonder if he's still here...” and decided to at least check.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm honored you remembered.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, I got you a present and everything!
Let's see, where is it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here! Happy birthday, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, is this soda candy?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I got it at the school store! I splurged a bit and got every bag they had♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You certainly don't do things by half-measures. Still...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems like quite a few people have a very strong impression that I like soda candy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, you do, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe, I certainly do.
I graciously accept.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Good!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, are you by yourself today? I thought you'd be hanging out with Tsukasa and the others.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They had wanted to as well, but unfortunately, circumstances didn't allow it. However, they did throw me a celebration over the weekend.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aw, I see. I hope it was a fun party.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Speak of the devil. It's Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What's going on? Is there something—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Good, he picked up!
Rui, are you still at school?”

rows.Speaker: Rui

rows.Line: Then, all the more reason for us to win this contest, and bring all of us another step forward!
